And this is the aspect of: "the voice is the voice of Yaakov" — the aspect of the windpipe which produces voice — and it is also in the aspect of: "acquire wisdom" [Mishlei 4:5] — which is the attribute of Yaakov. And Esav's hold is in the aspect of the esophagus — where the essential eating and drinking passes — etc. — as all of this is understood in the holy Zohar.

[§2]
And behold: Yaakov and Esav were both in one womb — and even at their birth it is said: "and his hand grasped the heel of Esav" — for the windpipe and the esophagus are by nature joined together in Creation. And therefore: if the esophagus separated from the windpipe — etc. — it is a treifah. For this is Yaakov's quality — not to separate the esophagus — which is the aspect of this world in which there is eating and drinking — from the World to Come — the aspect of the windpipe. For Yaakov too had to use the things of this world — only he did everything with wisdom — and all his deeds were for the sake of Heaven. Not so Esav — who corrupts the order of Creation and separates the aspect of this world from the World to Come entirely — which is the aspect of the esophagus being separated from the windpipe — and therefore it is a treifah — the aspect of the sitra d'mosa.

segments.he: וע"כ אם מפקיד או שולח ביד עכו"ם או חשוד דבר שיש בו חשש איסור דאורייתא אם יחליף צריכין חותם בתוך חותם כנגד בחינת התיקונים הנ"ל. כי המוחין והחמכה הם בחי'חותם בחי' תפלין מוחין שהם בחי' חותם כידוע וכן המלכו תהוא בחי' חותם כמו שדרז"ל (ב"ר פרשה וישב) חותמך ופתילך חותמך זה מלכות וכו' עיין שם:
segments.en:
[§3]
And this is the aspect of: the esophagus — which alludes to the aspect of this world — has two skins. The outer one is red — for in it the aspect of Esav the red one seizes most. And the inner one is white — for the inner dimension of this world is in the aspect of whiteness and brightness — the aspect of the World to Come — the aspect of the thirty-two paths [of wisdom] — whose acronym is lavan [white] — as is known. And therefore: if they were reversed — so that the outer is white and the inner is red — this is from the aspect of Esav — whose inner dimension is from the fierce power of judgment and the lusts of this world — and even when he performs something of holiness — which is the aspect of whiteness — the aspect of chasadim — the aspect of the World to Come — it is only in the aspect of externality — while his inner dimension is the aspect of Esav who is red. Therefore it is a treifah. And likewise if both are red. And if both are white — see in the Shulchan Aruch.

[§4]
And according to the opinion that forbids even this — it is a treifah — for this is the aspect of: *"do not be overly righteous"* [Koheles 7:16] — the aspect of Esav's questions: "how does one tithe straw?" — etc. One may also say: the esophagus — which is the aspect of this world — has in it the hold of Esav and Yishmael. Esav is red — and Yishmael is in the aspect of white — for they also count by the moon — and his suckling is from the side of kindness — the aspect of whiteness — from the side of Avraham. And therefore he is in the aspect of white milk — as stated. And therefore: when Yaakov went to Lavan — to subdue his klippa and clarify from him the holy sparks — as stated in Orach Chaim — then Esav went to Yishmael — etc. — in order to receive even more power from him — and to unite with him against Yaakov. And therefore: if they were reversed — this indicates the cunning of the yetzer hara — the aspect of Esav — dressing itself in mitzvos — which are the aspect of whiteness — but its inner intention is to do harm. And likewise if both are red or white — this indicates that the klippos of Esav and Yishmael united together to overpower Yaakov — and therefore it is a treifah. And likewise: if it has two esophagi or two windpipes — it is a treifah — for: "everything extra is as if removed." And it goes without saying regarding two esophagi — for in it is the essential hold of wicked Esav: "do not be overly wicked" — but even two windpipes — it is also a treifah — the aspect of: "do not be overly righteous." And also: "and do not be overly wise" [Koheles 7:16] — for one's deeds must be more than one's wisdom.

segments.he: סימן ק"כ
segments.en:
[§5]
And therefore: the essential fullness of acquiring wisdom and the World to Come is through acquiring holy Torah — which is the aspect of the central pillar — as stated. All of this we have written in a somewhat playful manner — as stated. And in truth it is difficult to explain all matters of treifos in detail — for they are numerous. But in general: there are organs that are the vessels of life-force.

[§6]
Such as the brain, the heart, and the lung — and within them too there are details: the skull and the membranes of the brain and the brain itself — and likewise the pericardium and the cardiac muscle and the cardiac chambers and the cardiac tube — and likewise the membranes of the lung and the lung tissue and the bronchial tubes. And there are the vessels of eating — the digestion of food — its purification and clarification — which are the intestines and the proventriculus and the crop and the stomach — etc. — and the liver and the gall bladder and the spleen — etc. — and likewise all of them.

segments.he: וע,כ כלי סעודה של עכו"ם של מתכות צריכין טבילה. כי גוף המאכל והסעודה שעל ידה חיות האדם היא בבחי' חכמה והכלי שאוכלין בה היא בבחינת מלכות. וע,כ כלי סעודה אפילו חדשים מאחר שהיו ברשות עכו"ם והיו מוכנים לסעודת עכו"ם שורה עליהם רוח הטומאה מבחינת מלכות דסט"א ששרשה מבחינת סוספיתא דדהבא בחינת השתלשלות הגבורות שהם בחי' אש שזה בחי' כלי מתכות שנעשה ע"י שניתך באש. וע"כ כשנכנסת לרשות ישראל צריכה טבילה במים ששרשם מבחי' חסדים בחי' חכמה בחינת תורה שע"י כל זה נמתקין הגבורות בשרשם ונתבטל בחינת הרוח שטות רוח הטומאה ועולה הכלי מטומאה לטהרה. ועל כן אם שאל או שכרכלי מן העכו"ם אז אין צריך טבילה, כי עדיין רשות בעליו עליו וגם כי אז אינו מתגבר כ"כ מאחר שלא יצא עדיין מרשות עכו"ם ועתיד לחזור לשם. משא"כ כשיצא מרשות עכו"ם לרשות ישראל אז מתגבר ביותר לינק מבחי' הקדושה ועל כן צריך טבילה
segments.en:
[§7]
And likewise there are vessels of the general structure of the body — such as the spine and the ribs. And vessels of the body's functioning — for standing and walking and lying and resting. And within each of these categories there are many particulars — as stated. And all of them allude spiritually to what they allude to — and everything is encompassed within the aspect of drawing these rectifications — which is the general of all. For Chochmah and intellect is the aspect of the totality of the first three [Keter, Chochmah, Binah]. Torah is the aspect of the central pillar — the aspect of the Vav of the extremities. And Malchus is the aspect of the sof davar [end of the matter] — as is known. And therefore our Sages received the halachic measure of all types of treifos of each and every organ as a law given to Moshe at Sinai — according to its aspect. For there are blemishes that relate essentially to the aspect of drawing Chochmah and intellect — the aspect of life-force. And there are blemishes that flow from having damaged against holy Torah — and the essential is through the sin of neglecting Torah — G-d forbid. And there are blemishes that flow from having damaged the aspect of Malchus. And in all of them our Sages received the true measure — in what manner the blemish can still be rectified easily — and then the treifah that descended through it does not entirely destroy the life-force of the creature — G-d forbid — but it can be healed — and over time it returns to health. And there are those where the blemishes prevailed so greatly — to the point that they affect the life-force — and it does not survive twelve months — as our Sages taught: "a treifah does not survive." And then it is forbidden — for the sitra achra has seized it — and will trap one's soul through this eating — G-d forbid.

segments.he: סימן קכ"א וכו'
segments.en:
[§8]
And therefore: if there is a doubt whether a treifah survived twelve months — or until it became pregnant and gave birth — it is in the presumption of being valid. For from this it is apparent and seen that the sitra d'mosa does not have hold upon it — for: "one who has no support does not produce fruit." And since it became pregnant and gave birth — it is apparent that it is from the side of holiness — which is the aspect of eternal life — the aspect of the world's sustenance through species. And it is in the aspect of what our Sages taught regarding a person — that one who leaves a son behind — etc. — is as if he did not die. And therefore it is said: "pure fat closes the hole" — for it is as the flesh itself — and therefore it naturally adheres to it well and closes. But impure fat — since it is from the aspect of the white of the sitra achra — as stated — it does not adhere as well to the flesh and does not close. And therefore: whatever in cattle corresponds to this is not closing in the chayah either — for it suffices to free itself by what the Torah permitted from the species of chayah — as stated — but not to close and save the creature from treifah — since it too does not naturally adhere to the flesh. But even so the Torah permitted it — as stated.

Siman 61 — Gifts to the Kohen: Foreleg, Cheeks, and Maw
סִימָן ס״א

segments.he: וע"כ כלים ישינים של עכו"ם אין די להם בטבילה, רק כתשמישם כך הכשירם.
segments.en:
[§1]
And therefore one must give the kohen the foreleg and the cheeks and the maw of the ox and the sheep — etc. — and it is explained in Likutay Torah of the Ari, Parshas Shoftim: the cheeks correspond to the three first [Keter, Chochmah, Binah] — and the foreleg corresponds to ChagaT — and the maw corresponds to NHY — where it rests. It emerges that they allude to the totality of the aspect of drawing these rectifications. And therefore they are given to the kohen — for in the priesthood there is also the aspect of the totality of all of them — (see Maurai Or) — and through this the rectification of the eating of meat is completed in its fullness. And therefore the chayah and fowl — in which the hold of the sitra achra is not as strong — as stated — do not require this rectification. And therefore the obligation is upon the slaughterer to give these gifts to the kohen — for he is the one engaged in the rectification of the animal through the shechitah — to sweeten the judgments at their root — to nullify from it the hold of foolishness and the sitra achra. And therefore he must complete the rectification through the gifts to the kohen — the man of kindness — and this is the aspect of: "for the kohen's lips shall guard knowledge — and Torah shall be sought from his mouth" [Malachi 2:7]. (See section 28.)

Siman 62 — Ever min HaChai: A Limb from a Living Animal
סִימָן ס״ב

segments.he: בבחי' כל דבר אשר יבא באש תעבירו באש כי מאחר שבלע מנוף מאכל האסור בעצמו שהוא מבחי' הסט"א ע"כ אם בלע ע"י אש צריך ליבון באש דייקא ואם בלע בחמין צריך הגעלה ואם בצונן די לו בשטיפה והדחה וכבר מבואר קצת מזה בחלק או"ח וענין נותן טעם לפגם וכלי שאינה בן יומא מבואר קצת לעיל
segments.en:
[§1]
And therefore it is forbidden to eat a limb from a living animal — and flesh that separates from a living animal. For as long as the judgments have not been sweetened at their root through the rectifications of shechitah — it is impossible to separate the evil and foolishness that has seized the spirit of the creature — which is the hold of the spirit of folly — the stormy spirit from the sitra achra of Esav. And therefore such eating greatly damages the soul. And also: because it is an extreme act of cruelty — which is from the quality of wild and impure animals — that tear and eat while alive — and these animals are the very opposite of the aspects of holy Chochmah and holy life-force — from which is the root of mercy and kindness and the nullification of all types of anger and rage and cruelty — as stated many times.

Siman 63 — Meat That Was Out of Sight
סִימָן ס״ג

segments.he: סימן קכ"ג וכו'
segments.en:
[§1]
And since the essential strengthening of the sitra achra in eating is in the eating of meat — as stated — one must guard it: and meat that was out of sight is forbidden unless according to the circumstances explained in the Shulchan Aruch — since we fear that perhaps it was exchanged through the aspect of the transpositions and substitutions of the sitra achra — and its palaces of transposition — which provoke to exchange and substitute — etc. — as is known.

segments.he: וע,כ חמור מאד איסור שתיית יינם של עכו"ם ואפילו במגעם לבד נאסר. כי מחמת שבקדושה הוא בשרשו גבוה מאד וכלול מכל בחי' התיקונים הנ"ל. כי הוא מבחינת חכמה ומוחין בחינת חמרא וריחא פיקחין ובבחי' תירה ובבח'י מלכות בחינת ויין מלכות רב וכו' וכמובן במאמר תהלה לדוד סימן י"ב וכן בזוה,ק וזה בחי'זכה נעשה ראש. וע"כ באמת צריכןי ליזהר בשתייתו מאד שלא להיות יותר מהמדה ח"ו כי יין המשכר הוא בחי' ההיפוך מכל הנ"ל. וע,כ נאסר במגע העכו"ם ופוגם בנפש ישראל השותה אותו ומתגבר עליו היצה"ר. ביותר עד שיוכל לבוא עי"ז לכל רע ח"ו. וזה בחינת ועל יינם משום בנותיהם ועיין בספר יין המשומר שהאריך הרבה בחומר האיסור ותבין משם לענינינו. וע,פ הנ"ל תבין לפרש כמה פסוקים ומאמרי רז"ל שמדברים בענין שתיית היין לשבח או להיפוך והכל מובן ע"פ הנ"ל
segments.en:
Siman 64, 65 and on — Fat, Blood, and the Thigh-Sinew
סִימָן ס״ד, ס״ה וְכוּ׳

[§1]
The matter of the prohibition of fat and blood is somewhat explained above. And likewise the thigh-sinew is forbidden — because Yaakov our father was pained in it when he wrestled with the guardian-prince of Esav — which is the aspect of the yetzer hara. And this sinew corresponds to Tisha b'Av — on which our holy Temple was destroyed — which encompasses all these rectifications — as explained in the section of Orach Chaim.

segments.he: סימן קל"ט וכו'
segments.en:
Siman 69 and on — Washing and Salting Meat
סִימָן ס״ט וְכוּ׳

[§1]
And therefore meat requires washing and salting — in order to wash away the visible blood upon it — which is forbidden as stated — and also to soften the meat so that the salt can extract the blood from it. For even though the meat has already been purified from the visible blood upon it — even so one must extract from it also the seeping blood [dam pelitah] — for even though the blood of the organs that has not seeped out is permitted — for this is the aspect of: *"He has not looked upon iniquity in Yaakov"* — and our Sages taught: evil thought — Hashem does not join it to action — for since it has not seeped out to bring the evil into actual deed — G-d forbid — in actual action — one is not punished for this since one prevailed over one's inclination in deed at least. Even so: one must purify the heart also from such thoughts — G-d forbid — and subdue also the evil within it that is only in potential — not in actual deed. For otherwise — G-d forbid — it is easy for the yetzer hara to prevail over one even in actual deed — G-d forbid. And this is the aspect of what one must salt the meat — so that it also expels the blood absorbed in the organs — for at the beginning of cooking — certainly the blood within it will seep and move from place to place and will forbid. And therefore salting is required — and the salt — through its pungency and saltiness — extracts even the blood absorbed in the organs.

segments.he: הלכות עבודה זרה. כי עיקר שורש כל הע"ז הוא מהיצר הרע שהוא בעצמו בחי' ע"ז כ"ש לא יהיה בך אל זר וכמו שדרז"ל וכן ארז,ל כך דרכו וכו' היום אומר לו וכו' ולמחר אומר לו לך עבוד ע"ז והוא עיקר הטומאה בחי' ההיפוך ממש מבחי' הקדושה כי הוא עיקר הסט,א והוא בחינת קיא צואה ממש כי אין שם כלל מבחינת הארת השכל דקדושה בבחינת וכבודי לאחר לא אתן וכמבואר במ"א וע"כ נקראים אלילים כי הם בחי' כלא ממש וכלאו כלום היפוך מבחי' החכמה דקדושה שהיא בחי' יש מאין כידוע. וע"כ אסורה הע"ז בהנאה כי כל הנאות האדם וקורת רוחו הוא בחי' ניצוץ מבחי' חלקי החיות שלו אבל ע"ז שהיא עיקר סטרא דמותא אסור לישראל לקבל ממנה שום הנאה ואיזה בחי' חיות כלל כי חיות כזה מר ממות ר"ל. וזה בחי' אסורה בהנאה היא ותשמישיה ונויה ותקרובתה. תשמישיה הם כנגד בחי' מלכות דסט"א. כי בזה שמשמש לפניה שזה בחי' עבד המשמש לרבו מראה בזה שמקבל עול מלכותה. ונויה הוא כנגד בחינת השכל דסט"א כי עיקר הנוי והיופי בשרשה הוא מבחי' החכמה שהיא בחי' אור בחי' חכמת אדם תאיר פניו.
segments.en:
[§2]
And likewise regarding the spiritual matter for the person: the salting is in the aspect of what our Sages taught: "let a person always arouse his yetzer tov against his yetzer hara" — meaning: one should not wait until the moment one sees one's inclination wanting to overpower and bring one to sin in actual deed — and only then gird one's battle weapons to fight it. But rather: while one's inclination is still only in potential — not yet in actual deed — at that point one arouses one's yetzer tov — and provokes it — and initiates battle against it — in order to drive it away entirely — so that it does not rule over one even only in the aspect of potential. And this is what is said: "tremble" — and certainly then: "and do not sin" — etc.

[§3]
And likewise: one who studies Torah with force and effort — and accepts upon himself suffering and bitterness for the sake of the yoke of Torah — as our Sages taught: "Torah only endures in one who kills himself over it." This too is the aspect of the rectification of the meat through salting as stated — as understood in the discourse Vayomar Boaz, Siman 65. (And see the holy Zohar, Vayechi 241 — regarding the sweetening of the judgments in the aspect of Malchus — which is through the aspect of salt — and from this the matter of salting is also understood.) And then after salting — one must go back and wash the meat and clean it of the salt — and of this blood that was expelled from it. And then the meat is permitted for eating — for there is no longer any hold of Esav the man of blood — even only in the aspect of potential.

segments.he: ותקרובתה הוא כנגד בחי' חיבור חמה ולבנה דסט"א ביחד ר"ל וכדין מטשטשי עלמא ר"ל. כי הסט"א הוא כקוף בפני אדם. ובקדושה (להבדיל) הקרבן הוא בבחי' קריבו דקוב"ה ושכינתיה כמובן בזוה,ק ופיזור לרשעים הנאה להם והנאה לעולם כי הם בבחי' פירוד כידוע. וע,כ הקרבן שלהם הוא פגם גדול ח"ו כי מורה על החיבור והיחוד ח,ו ביניהם. וע,כ ע"ז של עכו"ם אסורה מיד, כי הם מבחינתה. אבל של ישראל אינה אסורה עד שתיעבד. כי באמת בשורש קדושתו הוא רחוק ממנה לגמרי אבל אם כבר עבדו אותה אזי אדרבא מחמת שהיא של ישראל מקבלת עי"זאיזהבחי' כח ביותר מחמת שהוא של ישראל ששרשו בקדושה ע"כ ע"ז של ישראל אןי לה ביטול רק שצריכין לבער ולשרוף אותה לגמרי. אבל של עכו"ם יש לה ביטול כי אין לה כח כ"כ כי גם כל העכו"ם בעצמם הם כאין וכלא ממש וכמו שארז"ל וע"כ תיכף שמבטל העכו"ם את הע"ז בטל האיסור ממנה. אבל תקרובתה אין לה ביטול כי דבק שם כח בחי' האיסור והסט"א ביותר מחמת גודל פגם בחי' החיבור הנ"ל כי הם להוטים אחר זה ביותר כידוע. וע"F תשמישיה ונויה אע"פ שמועיל להם ביטול אעפ"כ אסורין לדבר מצוה משום דמאיסה.
segments.en:
[§4]
And therefore: meat that sat three days without washing and salting — salting no longer helps it — for its blood has dried within it. And this is like what our Sages taught [Bava Kamma 82]: "and they walked three days in the wilderness and found no water" — etc. — since they walked three days without Torah — they grew tired. And our Sages standing among them arose and ordained — etc. — so that they not rest three days without Torah. And it is already explained: the rectification of meat through washing and salting is the aspect of subduing the yetzer hara — the aspect of Esav — whose essential subduing is through the waters of Torah and wisdom. And therefore: if it sat three days — etc. — the aspect of having been separated from Torah in the three days mentioned — then certainly the blood within it has already hardened and dried — to the point that it is already difficult to extract and expel it — even through washing and salting. And therefore one may not eat it except roasted — and since one has roasted it — even so one should not cook it initially — as explained in the Shulchan Aruch. And therefore: if it was soaked in water within the three days — one is permitted to keep it until close to another three days.

segments.he: כי במצוה וקדושה שם עיקר היופי וההידור דקדושה. אבל הסט"א בחי' ע"ז ותשמישיה אפילו אחר שנתבטלו אעפ"כ נמאסין לעשות עמהם דבר מצוה וקדושה:
segments.en:
[§5]
And from this matter something is understood: why sometimes specifically then — when one's inclination provokes one even more — with confusions and thoughts — etc. — things that had not entered one's mind before. And this is like the aspect of the rectification of salting — where at first — and especially after washing — the meat is clean and no moisture of blood is visible upon it — and then specifically through the salting the meat fills with brine and blood expelled from it. For at first the blood was absorbed in the organs — and now it has come out and been expelled through the salting — and therefore the meat became soiled again — until it is washed a second time — and then it will truly be clean of all blood — both outside and inside. (And this is somewhat explained in the conversations.) And therefore one must be especially careful at that time — not to allow any weakening of the mind to fall in one's heart through the aspect of this increased provocation. For such is the matter — for this itself is its purification and rectification — as stated. But even so — one must not be pleased with this — G-d forbid. Rather: one must immediately strengthen against the confusions and drive them away with all one's power — and at least flee from them immediately to holiness. And at least one must not be as one who contemplates and returns and contemplates again — G-d forbid. And this is understood also from elsewhere. And this is the aspect of what one must salt in a perforated vessel specifically — so that there is a place for the brine and blood that are expelled to flow out. But if there is no place for it to flow out — then not only is what was soaked in the brine and blood forbidden — for the blood re-absorbed into it — and salting and roasting no longer help it. But even the entire piece outside the brine was also forbidden — for the blood within it moved from place to place and did not exit — since it had no place to flow out.

[§6]
And this corresponds to the spiritual matter: since one does not hasten to drive away all the confusions and soilings that come upon one's heart specifically now — but rather one appears as if — G-d forbid — one is pleased by this — then not only do they themselves cleave and seize in one's heart — to the point that it is hard to purify oneself from them afterward — but all one's brain and heart become confused and disordered through this even more.

segments.he: סימן קמ"ב וכו'
segments.en:
[§7]
For since one engages in Torah and service somewhat — whose special quality is to subdue the yetzer hara and purify the heart from all dross — even from what is still only in potential — this itself is the cause and reason why it seems that they provoke and cling to one even more right now — as stated. And if one were strong in this frame of mind — and each time some confusion comes upon one's heart — one drives it away immediately and gives it a place to flow and exit from oneself — and afterwards some other confusion would come upon one's heart and one would also drive it away — and so each time — until one merited true purity of heart — in the aspect of: *"and You shall cast into the depths of the sea all their sins"* [Michah 7:19] — to a place where — etc. — "and they shall never rise to the heart again." But if when some confusion comes — etc. — one does not immediately give it place to exit — but grasps it and deepens it and repeats its foolishness — G-d forbid — then one is like one who immerses while holding an impurity in one's hand.

[§8]
And from this it is self-evident: even though meat salted in a non-perforated vessel is permanently forbidden — and no rectification helps it — according to us — as stated. But with a person — certainly there is nothing that stands before repentance — and if one now truly strengthens oneself — and pierces one's stony heart — and engages in the service of Hashem in truth — certainly everything will be rectified. And therefore: if one has no salt — one roasts the meat over fire — for the power of fire also draws out the seeping blood — such that the blood absorbed in it will not seep and spread further.

segments.he: וע"כ אסורין כל הנאות הבאות ממנה וכו' ואסור לשמוע בקול השיר שלה וכן להסתכל בנויה ולהריח בריח שהל. כיכל זה תלוי במוח שבו מקור כל החושים של שמע וראיה וריח. וע,כ יפגום עי"ז מאד בבחי' המוח והשכל דקדשוה. ועל כן אם אינו מתכוין מותר. מאחר שנעשה ממילא בלי כונה ודעת רק באופן דלא הוי פסיק רישא וכו' כמבואר בשו"ע:
segments.en:
[§9]
And therefore: regarding seeping blood [dam pelitah] — we say: since it is busy seeping it does not absorb — and likewise: as it absorbs so it expels. But not regarding visible blood — and likewise not regarding other prohibitions such as brine of neveilah and treifah. For with seeping blood — since before it seeped out it was not in the category of prohibition — for the blood of the organs that had not seeped was permitted — as stated — only since we are concerned that it will seep out afterwards — therefore one engages with it to extract and expel it — and therefore we are not as concerned about it. But regarding visible blood and other prohibitions — where the sitra achra has already seized them more strongly — one must keep far from them — and the arguments mentioned do not apply.

[§10]
And therefore: the liver — since it is full of blood — and in it is the essential hold of Esav the red one — as understood in the discourse Sha'alu, Siman 57 — and this is the aspect of: *"and Edom came out to meet him with a heavy people"* [Bamidbar 20:20] [am kaved — which also means liver] — therefore salting does not help for the liver — only roasting over fire — the aspect of: *"and the house of Yaakov shall be fire"* [Ovadyah 1:18] — etc. — "and the house of Esav shall be stubble" — etc.

segments.he: קמ"ו וע"כ עכו"ם יכול לבטל ע"זאפילו אינה שלו ואפילו בעל רחו אבל מי שאינו עובד ע"ז כגון גר תושב או ישמעאל אינם יכולים לבטל. כי באמת בחי' ע"ז היא בטלה מעיקרא וכלא חשיבא כנ"ל וכ"ש כי כל אלהי העמים אלילים. ועיקר בח'י יניקת כחה שהיאבשביל כח הבחירה כידוע הוא רק עי"ז, בעצמו שנמצאים בנ"א המאמיני' בה ועובדים אותה ובזה משפיעי' בה איזה בחי' יניקה וכח בשביל הבחירה וזה בחי' משארז"ל אלהיהם של עכו"ם הם מתקיימם על אלהיהם. היינו שהעבודים אותה משפיעים בהם איזה בחינת כח.
segments.en:
[§11]
And therefore our Sages taught: blood is not retained in intestinal walls — for our Sages taught: intestinal walls are not flesh — and those who eat them are not fully human beings. And therefore: since they are not fully suited as human food — the bloods do not seize in them as strongly — unless we see that they reddened — which indicates there is in them the aspect of the hold of Esav the red one. And therefore one must salt intestinal walls on the outside — where the fat adheres — for their fat is regarded as blood — since there is the essential hold of: "and Yeshurun grew fat and kicked" — as stated. And therefore: visible blood that fell on roasting meat — we say the opposite: the fire absorbs it. For this is the aspect of: "one who provokes the yetzer hara within oneself" — for the fire of Torah and holy intellect subdues only the power of the sitra achra and the yetzer hara that is by nature in a person — and through this what happens naturally happens to it. But when a person deliberately seeks out and calls his inclination and awakens it upon himself — G-d forbid — then it can happen that it overpowers him even more specifically — as our Sages taught regarding one who teaches his daughter Torah: it is as if he taught her frivolity — as it is said: "I wisdom dwell with cunning" [Mishlei 8:12] — etc. — see there.

segments.he: וזה בחינת כמוהם יהיו עושיהם כל אשר בוטח בהם כי הע"ז בעצמם אין להם שום כח וממש בבחי' פה להם ולא ידברו וכו' רק מה שנדמה להעובדים שיש בה איזה בחינת כח וממשות הוא עי,ז בעצמו שעובדים אותה ובוטחים בה שזה עיקר עשייתה בבחינת עושיהם כל אשר בוטח בהם.
segments.en:
Siman 79 and on — Signs of Pure and Impure Animals
סִימָן ע״ט וְכוּ׳

[§1]
The signs of a pure animal and chayah are chewing the cud and having a split hoof. For our Sages taught: examine the teeth and you will forget the shoes [meaning: the signs indicate each other]. And behold: a person has thirty-two teeth — corresponding to the thirty-two paths of Chochmah — from which is the essential rectification of eating — as all of this is explained in the kavanos. And through them is the essential power of the feet — for "the end is embedded in the beginning." And the light of holy Chochmah and holy Torah illuminate a person from the aspect of his head to his feet — the aspect of: *"a lamp to my feet is Your word — and a light to my path"* [Tehillim 119:105]. And this is the aspect of: "the wisdom of the prudent — he understands his way" [Mishlei 14:8] — the aspect of: "and the path of the righteous is as the shining light" — as explained within. And see in the discourse of the Ari at the end of the Tikkunim — on the verse: "I have pondered my ways and I have returned my feet" — etc. And also: Malchus corresponds to the aspect of the feet — as is known. And this is the aspect of our Sages' teaching: it was found to illuminate his eyes and make him stand on his feet.

segments.he: וע,כ הם עצמם דייקא יכולים לבטלה אבל לא מי שאינו עובד אותם. ועל כן אם נשברה מאליה אסורה ג"כ עד שיבטלוה. כי מה בכך שנשברה מאליה הלא היא כשבורה ובזויה גם מעיקרא רק העיקר שעובדיה בעצמם יבטלו אותה. וע"כ המוצא ע"ז צריך שיבערנה ויאבדנה וצריך לשרש אחריה ולכנות לה שם גנאי. כי צריך לבער ולבטל כל מיני אחיזת הסט"א והיצה,ר שהם בחי' ע"ז עד שלא ישאר להם שום שורש וענף כלל כי היום אומר ל ועשה כך וכו' וכן צריכין לכנות לה שם גנאי כיהיא עצמה כלא ממש רק שעיקר כחה ע"י השם שקורין לה העובדים אותה ומכנין אותה בשם אלוה. וענין השם של כל דבר הוא בשרשו דבר גדול כי שם מרמז לבחי' חכמה ולבחי' מלכות בחי' כבוד כנ"ל. וע,כ אנשים גדולים ומכובדיטם נקראים אנשי שם. וע"כ צריכין לכנות שם ע"ז לגנאי וביזיון היפוך החן והכבוד הנ"ל וע"כ אסור להזכר שמה מכש"כ שלא לשבע בשם ע"ז ואפילו שלא לגרום לעכו"ם שישבע בשם ע"ז כמבואר בשו"ע:
segments.en:
[§2]
And behold: correspondingly — the kingdom of the sitra achra — the aspect of Esav — also encompasses these two aspects of the klippa. And this is the aspect of what is said [Daniel 7] regarding the fourth beast: "its great iron teeth — eating and crushing — and its remainder it trampled with its feet." And therefore: in cattle and beasts — in which the filth of Esav and the spirit of folly and foolishness — the opposite of holy Chochmah — which is the essential aspect of human being — seizes most — therefore when it has teeth or fangs in the upper jaw — since then it generally does not chew its cud — for it chews and grinds its food with its teeth very well — until the food digests easily within it — and does not return and rise again into its mouth. And therefore it does not chew its cud. And it also does not have split hooves — so that it has an especially strong hold with its hooves on the ground. And therefore these are signs of impurity — for this indicates that the spirit of the sitra achra has seized it greatly — that it is addicted to the pleasure of eating — and imagines it has a firm and complete footing in this world.

[§3]
But if it chews its cud — this is because it has no teeth in the upper jaw — and therefore it cannot thoroughly chew and grind its food — and therefore the food returns and rises again into its mouth each time. And its hooves are split — so that it does not have as firm a hold with its hooves. From this it is apparent that the spirit of animality in it does not have great power and hold — and especially in the matter of its eating — where is the essential hold of animality — and where is the essential hold of Esav. And therefore: when one sees these signs — from its teeth to its hooves — one thereby knows that it is pure — for the sitra achra has not ruled it so strongly — and it is therefore fit for Israel's eating. And one may also say: the matter of chewing its cud alludes to the quality of the righteous — who minimize eating and drinking — the aspect of: "a righteous person eats to satisfy his soul" [Mishlei 13:25] — and many times they fast entirely — for they accustom themselves to the quality of the World to Come — in which there is no eating and drinking. But even so — as long as they are in this world — they too are compelled to eat and drink — the aspect of: "when you arrive in the city — proceed according to its customs." And since for them it is only in the aspect of necessity — they suffice with a small amount. And the unpleasantness of being full equals for them — each time — what they already ate yesterday or many hours ago — which is the aspect of chewing the cud — being sustained from what one ate already.

segments.he: סימן קמ"ח וכו'
segments.en:
[§4]
And also: since their eating is only out of necessity and not for their own pleasure — they are in the aspect of the angels when they came to Avraham our father in this world — they were compelled to eat — and it is said of them: "and they ate" — and our Sages taught: and did they actually eat? — but they appeared as eating. And the first of each [food] departed [within them immediately] — likewise the eating of the righteous: it only appears as physical eating like other people — but in truth they are utterly distant from it — and even during the eating their mind is bound above above — and they are nourished only from the light of supernal Chochmah. And this is also the aspect of chewing the cud — appearing as if eating and not eating.

[§5]
And the split hooves also indicate the quality of the righteous — who have no firm footing in this world — but are always in the aspect of: "spread out the split of Your kingdom" — for they have doubts and uncertainty — and division — also regarding their reward in the World to Come. And as our Sages taught: why is the letter lulav dotted [in the verse about the gifts to Yosef]? David said: I know there is reward for the righteous in the World to Come — but I do not know whether I have a share with them. And Rabbi Yochanan ben Zakkai said: two paths are before me — etc. Whereas the quality of the wicked is all the opposite — for they are deeply addicted to the lusts of this world — and cannot satisfy themselves — the aspect of: "and the dogs — etc. — know not satisfaction" [Yeshayahu 56:11] — and: "and the belly of the wicked shall want" [Mishlei 13:25]. And this is the aspect of: an impure animal does not chew its cud — for immediately after it swallows the food — its memory is as if erased — and it only anticipates more food. And even during the eating it becomes completely seized and bound by the physical pleasure of eating — for it thoroughly chews the food with its teeth — and fulfils its desire to the extent possible. And even so: they know not satisfaction — and it is as if it ate nothing at all. And its hooves are closed — for it imagines its footing in this world is firm. And not only that — but it is confident that it will also have reward in the World to Come. And these aspects are signs of impurity.

segments.he: וע,כ אסור לישא וליתן עמהם ביום חגם וכו' וכן עוד כמה הלכות המבוארים בסימנים אלו ולהלן והכל בכדי שלא יהיה לנו שום חלק בשמחתם ועבודתם ושלא ליתןלהם שום כח ושום אחיזה כלל. וזה בחי' הלאו של לא תחנם.
segments.en:
[§6]
And therefore: all that chews its cud — it has a split hoof — except the camel — etc. — and all that has a split hoof — it chews its cud — except the pig — etc. — for our Sages taught: the camel — this is Babylon; the shafan [hyrax] — this is Persia; the arnevet [hare] — this is Greece; the pig — this is Edom. It emerges that these species allude to the totality of the kingdoms of the sitra achra. And since Israel must be in exile under their dominion — therefore there is in them some sign of purity — so that they not be as complete opposites of the holiness of Israel. And the very sign of purity indicates the aspect of the holy sparks that fell among them — for whose sake Israel must be subjugated under them — until they clarify all the holy sparks from among them — as is known. And this also alludes to what the yetzer hara first dresses itself in mitzvos — as explained within — and this too is for this reason — for it is difficult for it to incite a person immediately at the first moment from one opposite to the other. And this is the aspect of our Sages' teaching about the pig — that it stretches out its hooves saying: see that I am pure — etc. — as stated.

segments.he: תחנם דייקא שלא להמשיך עליהם בחינת חן בחי' החי"ת והנו"ן הנ"ל. כי הם ההיפוך מבחי' החן דקדושה. ועיין ע"ז דך כ' שדרז"ל לא תחנם לא תתן להם חנייה בקרקע. ד"א לא תחנם לא תתן להם חן ד"א לא תחנם לא תתן להם מתנות חנם ועיין שו"ע סימן קנ"א והכל סובב על ענין הנ"ל:
segments.en:
[§7]
And therefore: an impure animal that gave birth to something resembling a pure animal — etc. — it is forbidden. For since its source is from the side of the sitra achra and impurity — therefore even the signs of purity do not help it — for they are in the aspect of the yetzer hara dressing in mitzvos — and in truth it is a mitzvah that comes through transgression. And therefore: a pure animal that gave birth to something resembling an impure animal — it is permitted. For since it is clearly known that its source is from the side of purity — one does not pay attention to the signs of impurity — for presumably they are in the aspect of: "great is transgression performed for its own sake" — and: "a prophet who was commanded to transgress the words of Torah temporarily — one listens to him." And our Sages taught: "there is a time to act for Hashem — they have nullified Your Torah" [Tehillim 119:126] — and similarly. And the matter of the chayah — whose fat is permitted and whose blood is forbidden — is already explained above.

Siman 82 — Signs of Pure Fowl
סִימָן פ״ב

segments.he: סימן קנ"ז
segments.en:
[§1]
And therefore fowl — which are light of movement and the light of life shines in them greatly — as stated — therefore there are very many species of pure ones among them. And only twenty-four impure species exist — which have some hold from the power of fierce judgments — that extend from the aspect of twenty-four courts [of judgment] — as is known. But since there are also impure species among them — therefore one who does not recognize them checks: any bird of prey that seizes — is certainly of an impure species — for one sees in it the quality of cruelty of wild animals — for the sake of eating. And likewise: if it catches from the air and eats immediately — without first placing on the ground — from all this it is apparent that it is greatly addicted to eating — and this is a sign of impurity. For it is from the sitra achra of Esav — as stated — and it is thereby known that it is a bird of prey and impure. And if it is known not to be a bird of prey: there are three signs of purity — etc. — and even so one may not eat it except by tradition — for we fear that perhaps it is from the aspect of the yetzer hara dressing itself in mitzvos and signs of purity — as stated.

Siman 83 — Signs of Pure Fish
סִימָן פ״ג

segments.he: על כל עבירות שבתורהוכו' יעבור ואל יהרג וכו'. כי נשמת ישראל וחיותם הק' נמשך ממקור החכמה העליונה שמשם שורש כל התורה.
segments.en:
[§1]
And therefore also in fish — which were created only from water and are in the aspect of the open eye — as stated — even so there are among them impure species as well — for this reason — and therefore holy Torah gave signs for them: "all that has a fin and scales" [Vayikra 11:9]. The scales are crowns and protection for their flesh — and the fin enables them to swim swiftly and flee from those who pursue them. And therefore they are signs of purity — for the wise person has eyes in his head — and knows that the world is full of enormous trials and dangers — for there are many enemies and lurkers and inciters and accusers against a person. And therefore he is careful for his soul — to hold a shield and barrier and armor to protect himself. And likewise: he hastens each time to flee from what one must flee from — and be saved. Not so the fool who walks in darkness — and pays no attention to any of this — as the verse says: *"a wise person is fearful and turns from evil — and a fool is confident and reckless"* [Mishlei 14:16].

[§2]
And this is the aspect of: "all who have scales — have fins" — for one who has no scales to protect himself constantly — certainly it is difficult to be saved and one falls most times into the hands of one's enemies and stumbles in what one stumbles in. And then one automatically weakens afterwards even in using one's fins to flee from them — for on the contrary — G-d forbid — since: "one sin draws another" — as our Sages taught. And the essential shield and armor before the enemy — the yetzer hara — is holy Torah — as the verse says: *"He stores away sound wisdom for the upright — a shield to those who walk in integrity"* [Mishlei 2:7]. And this is what our Sages asked: since it is already written scales — why also write fin? — and they answered: yagdil Torah v'yadir [to magnify the Torah and make it glorious].

segments.he: וע"F פיקוח נפש אחת מישראל דוחה שבת וכן כל המצוות אך אם העכו"ם מכוין להעבירו על דת אז אם הוא בפני עשרה מישראל ע"כ אם ישמע להעכו"ם יש חילו השם בדבר ונמצא ממילא פוגם מאחד בשורש חיותו כי כל מה שברא הקב"ה לא ברא אלא לכבודו. והכבוד הוא בחי' חכמה כידוע ע"כ אפילו על ערקתא דמסאני (שישראל נוהגין כדי שיהיה הפרש ביניהם לבין העכו"ם) יהרג ואל יעבור. וכן על ע"ז וג"ע וש"ד אפ י' בצינעה ואין העכו"ם מכוין אלא להנאתו יהרג ואל יעבור כי על ש,ד סברא הוא מאי חזית וכו' דילמא דמא דחברך סמיק טפי כי אולי חיותו של חבירו נמשך עוד מבחי' גבוה ביותר. וכן ע"י עז,ז ח"ו פוגם בוודאי בכל שורש חיותו כעיהוא ככופר בכל התורה כולה. וכן הפגם של ג"ע גדול מאד ופוגם בכל חיותו וכפוגם בכל התורה כולה וגורם בחי' פירוד ח"ו ביחוד הק' ומשפיע כח וחיות לסט"א ח"ו ע"כ יהרג ואל יעבור ועי"ז נעשה תיקון גדול למעלה כידוע. ומעלה בזה ניצוצות הק' הרבה ובחי' החיות דקדושה המלבוש בסטרא דמותא ג"כ ואז יתפרדו כל פועלי און ובלע המות לנצח וכל קרני רשעים אגדע תרוממנה קרנות צדיק
segments.en:
[§3]
Meaning: holy Torah alludes to us all the counsel and strategies needed for this battle — and therefore even though it is already self-evident that all who have scales have fins — even so holy Torah explains it explicitly — to make known that even this counsel — to flee when one must flee — all of it is only through the power of holy Torah — through which one gives strength to holy Malchus — the aspect of the yetzer tov — to prevail against the yetzer hara — as stated. And this: yagdil Torah — and through this: v'yadir — which is from the language of strengthening and power — and also from the language of rule and mastery — the aspect of the holy power that Malchus receives through this — as stated. And this is what our Sages taught: from where [do we know] that scales are a garment? — as it is written: "and an armor of scales" [Shmuel I 17:5] — it is thereby explained: scales are the aspect of a shield and armor and coat of mail. And see in the book of Ta'amei HaMitzvos and you will understand further for our subject.

segments.he: סימן קנ"ח
segments.en:
Siman 84 — Laws of Insects
סִימָן פ״ד

[§1]
The laws of insects. And this is the aspect of the impurity of the eight creeping creatures mentioned in the Torah — which are the weasel, the mouse — etc. — and it is cited in the writings that they correspond to the aspects of the roots of the klippos mixed in the dross of the eight kings of Edom — etc. And regarding our subject: for they are from the sitra achra of Esav — who is Edom — who grows strong essentially to separate a person from holy Chochmah — the aspect of ches. And therefore correspondingly they too are eight [ches]. And holy Chochmah is the aspect of holiness. And they are completely impure — the opposite of the aspect of holiness. And therefore their impurity is as a lentil — which is the aspect of what was the beginning of Esav's wickedness — and the despising of the birthright — which is the aspect of holy Chochmah — was for the sake of a lentil stew — as is explained in the parashah. And this is also the aspect of the prohibition of: "all the creeping creature that creeps upon the earth" — and the Torah calls them sheketz [abomination] — etc. — for they are of very low levels — the very opposite of the aspect of holy life-force — which is the aspect of ches and nun — the aspects of grace and beauty and splendor — and they are disgusting and repulsive. Therefore: "you shall not make your souls abominable through animal or through bird" — and similarly regarding the impure species of water — it is said of them: sheketz — for all of them are from the aspect of the sitra achra — which is disgusting and abominable — the aspect of what our Sages taught: "if that villain encounters you — etc." — the aspect of what is said [Yirmiyahu 49] about Edom: "contemptible among men." And therefore they make the souls of those who eat them abominable.

segments.he: וע"כ אסור לרפאות את העכו"ם ולהצילו מן המיתה. מאחר שהם בעצם בבחינת סטרא דמותץא אבל אף על פי כן אין מצוה להורגם כי מסתמא יש גם בהם איזה צורך להעולם בשביל קיום הבחירה. אבל המינים והאפיקורסים והמוסרים ועוברי עבירות להכעיס מצוה לסבב מיתתם. כי מאחר שעוקרים עצמם מקדושת ישראל הדבקים במקור החיים דקדושה וירדו ברשעתם לתכלית שפלות מדריגת בחי' סטרא דמותא ע"כ מצוה לבערם טן העולם בכדי שלא תתגבר ביותר בחי' סטרא דמותא בעולם ר"ל.
segments.en:
[§2]
And therefore they are forbidden only if the insects grew while still attached [to the ground] — which is called "the creeping creature that creeps upon the earth." But those that form in something detached are not forbidden unless they separated — for the essential distinction between a human being and an animal is: the spirit of the human ascends upward — and the spirit of the animal descends downward to the earth — and therefore it is greatly addicted to physicality and earthliness — and has no daas or intellect. And therefore: insects that creep literally on the earth — and all their growth is close to the actual earth — they are therefore very weak and of very little life-force. And as our Sages taught: any creature that has no bone does not survive twelve months. And therefore all of them are forbidden. And likewise water insects that spring up while attached — or at least flow — etc. — as explained in the Shulchan Aruch. But those in water in vessels — and likewise those in fruits — those that formed in something detached — are not in the category of "the creeping creature that creeps on the earth" — unless they separated. For then the spirit of impurity — wandering the earth — from the aspect of the sitra achra of Esav — has already seized them. And the general rule: those insects that formed while attached are from the aspect of the sitra achra — the aspect of Esav — of whom it is said: "the wicked are estranged from the womb" [Tehillim 58:4]. And therefore they are forbidden immediately. But those waters or fruits that were detached from their place of attachment in purity and fitness — and had no insects in them at that time — and were fit then for Israel's food without any checking at all — therefore: if insects formed in them afterwards — they are permitted as long as they have not separated. For they are in the aspect of: "He has not looked upon iniquity in Yaakov" — as stated — since they are included in the permitted food and have not separated and distinguished themselves from it at all — the name of prohibition has not fallen upon them. (And even if they separated — in a place of rabbinic lenience — see in the Shulchan Aruch the particulars.) But if they separated from the produce or food and became a matter in their own right — the sitra achra has already found a place to fall upon them — and then even if they return — they are forbidden. And from this some small allusions are also understood regarding a person's service.

Siman 85 — Signs of Pure Locusts
סִימָן פ״ה

segments.he: וע"כ העובר עבירה רק לתיאבון כי לא יכול להתגבר על יצרו אסגור לעמוד על דמו ומצוה להצילו כי הוא דבוק עדיין בקדושת ישראל ובבחי' החיים דקדושה רק שלא יכול להתגבר על יצרו ולכבוש את בחירתו ובוודאי יקבל ענשו אבל אעפ"כ גם בשעת העבירה יש לו צער מזה שבא לידי מדה זו ויודע כי מרה תהיה באחרונה ואולי יזכה עוד לחרטה באמת ולתשובה שלימה וכ"ש (קהלת ט') כי מי אשר יחובר אל כל החיים יש בטחון ופירש רש"י אפילו הוא רשע ונתחבר לרשעים וכו' יש בטחון שמא ישוב לפני מותו.
segments.en:
[§1]
The signs of locusts: all that has four legs and four wings — and its wings cover the majority of its body — etc. — and it has two jumping legs. For from all of this it is apparent that its power of movement is greatest — to flee from enemies — and also its wings cover the majority of its body like a shield and armor — as stated — and also its power of flight is very great. And not only that — but it also has jumping legs — to leap and spring above the physicality of the earthly place. And all of these are signs of its purity. And even so: a tradition is required that its name is chagav — a pure species — for the sitra achra also sometimes makes use of and dresses itself in these aspects. And specifically because it is so light of movement — even so: since there are also impure species among them — the error and exchange and transposition are very common — and therefore a tradition is specifically required. And therefore the pure ones require no shechitah — for the majority of them is from the finest elements — and the minority from the element of earth.

Siman 86 — Signs of Eggs
סִימָן פ״ו

segments.he: היינו כנ"ל. ובזה מבואר שם כל ענין הפסוק כי לכלב חי טוב מן האריה המת כי החיים יודעי םשימותו והמתים אינם יודעים מאומה. היינו כי כל זמן שלא עקר את עצמו מן החים דקדושה לגמרי אע"פ שלא יכול להתגבר על יצרו אעפ"כ היה לו צער מזה כי יודע שעומד למיתה וליתן דין וחשבון עלכל דבר ע"כ הוא בבחי' הכלב החי שהוא במדריגה פחותה ושפלה מאדכמובן במה שארז"ל מהו לסרוסי כלבא ואעפ"כ הוא טיוב מן האריה המת. היינו ממי שעוקר את עצמו מן החיים דקדושה לגמרי והוא מין או בעל עבירות להכעיס שאז אע"פ שהוא חי ומתגבר ומצליח מאד אעפ"כ הוא בבחי' אריה המת ומצוה לבערו מן העולם שלא יבאיש את הארץ אבל אם אינו עובר רק לתיאבון ולא להכעיס שיודע שימות ומתיירא מזה אז הוא עדיין בכלל התחברות אל כל החיים ויש לו תקוה ובטחון לשוב בתשובה ומצוה להצילו ולהחיותו כנ"ל
segments.en:
[§1]
The signs of eggs — to recognize whether they are from pure fowl: if both its heads are round or both are pointed — or if the yolk was on the outside and the white on the inside — it is known to be the egg of an impure bird — etc.

segments.he: סימן קנ"ט וכו'
segments.en:
[§2]
For a pointed head alludes to the sharpening of the mochin — the aspect of the light of supernal Chochmah — the aspect of what is said [Iyov 41:22]: "beneath him are sharp pieces of pottery" — Rashi explains: rays of the sun — which is the aspect of the light of Chochmah. And likewise: [Mishlei 27:17]: "and a man sharpens the face of his fellow" — Rashi explains: referring to Torah scholars who sharpen each other. And a round head alludes to the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of a circle — the aspect of: "and the head is round toward the throne from behind" — and as cited in the discourse Heichal HaKodesh, Siman 59. And it is known: the sitra achra begins in connection and ends in separation — the aspect of: "then all evildoers shall be scattered" [Tehillim 92:10]. And therefore: if both its heads are round — it alludes to it being from the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra. And likewise: if both its heads are pointed — it alludes to it being from the aspect of the male — the aspect of the intellect of the sitra achra.

[§3]
And therefore: even a pure egg — whose one head is round and one head is pointed — one does not rely on it until asking the hunter — etc. — for in holiness there is a complete and holy union between male and female — which are the aspects of Chochmah and Malchus. And therefore the essential binding of the egg is in its pointed head — where the drop of the male bird binds — as explained in the Beis Yosef, Siman 66, in the name of most authorities — see there. And this: for this very pointed head is also in the aspect of the male — as stated. And according to the opinion that holds the binding is in the round head — this too can be explained according to the matter above — as is self-evident. And therefore: if the yolk is on the outside and the white is on the inside — this too is a sign that it is from an impure bird. For the white — which is white — is from the aspect of the male — the aspect of: "a man who emits white" — etc. — and the yolk is from the aspect of the female. And in the sitra achra — the female rules over the male — as explained in the holy Zohar regarding yoter al hakaved [the lobe of the liver] — and likewise regarding pitora asher al ha-nahar [the table that is on the river]. But even if one head is round and one pointed — and the white is on the outside and the yolk inside — even so it is possible that it is the egg of an impure bird. For falsehood does not endure unless there is some truth at its beginning. And likewise: the sitra achra also begins in connection — from which flows the fact that the yetzer hara first dresses itself in mitzvos — for they mimic like a monkey before a man. Therefore one does not rely on these signs until asking the hunter — etc. — as explained in the Shulchan Aruch.

segments.he: ענין איסור רבית. כי ע"י שמלוין לעני או אף לעשיר כשצריך ללוות שזה בעצמו בחי' עניות כל זה נמשך בשרשו מבחי' העניו' של בחי' מלכות דקדושה שהיא בבחי' מסכן וחכם כנ"ל ובאתערותא דלתתא איתער לעילא ועל כן ע,י צדקה וגמ"ח עי"ז נמשך ומאיר הארת בחי' החכמה העליונה (ששם שורש בחינת העשירות כשארז"ל כיון שנתחכה נתעשר וכו') על בחי'המלכות דקדושה ואז הוא עולה מבחי' עניות ונעשה אור הלבנה כאור החמה שזה בחי' חן כנ"ל. וע"כ נקרא הלואה כזו בלשון חכמים בשם הלואת חן וכן בלשון הכתוב טוב איש חונן ומלוה.
segments.en:
Nachas HaShulchan — Part VII (Yoreh Deah) · Segment 2 · Simanim 30–87

Translated faithfully from the Hebrew of Rabbi Nachman of Tchehrin ז״ל

segments.he: וזה וכי ימוך אחיך וכו' והחזקת בו וכו' וחי עמך ועיקר החיות מבחינת החכמה תחיה וכו' כנ"ל. וזה אל תקח מאתו נשך ותרבית כי על ידי זה אדרבא הוא מושך ויונק החית של תמצית הדם שלו.
segments.en:
Nachas HaShulchan — Part VII (Yoreh Deah), Segment 3: Simanim 87–178

נַחַת הַשֻּׁלְחָן

segments.he: ונתגדל עי"ז עניותו ביותר וזה ויראת מאלהיך בחי'מוראה של מלכות. וחי אחיך עמך בחי' החכמה תחיה. וזה שסיים אני ה' אלהיכם דרז"ל שבמצוה זו מקבל על עצמו עול מלכות שמים אם לאו להיפוך ח"ו היינו כנ"ל. וזה שאמרז"ל על המלוה ברבית כאלו כופר בתחיית המתים.
segments.en:
Nachas HaShulchan — Part VII
Yoreh Deah · Segment 3 · Simanim 87–178

segments.he: ששרשה מבחי' החכמה תחיה. וביציאת מצרים.
segments.en:
Basar b'Chalav · Taaruvos · Foods of Non-Jews · Avodah Zarah · Ribbis · Kilayim

By Rabbi Nachman of Tchehrin ז״ל

segments.he: שהוא בחי' עליות המלכות כידוע. וזה לנכרי תשיך כי עי"ז מוציא ממנו ניצוצי בחינת החיות דקדושה שנפלו לשם. אבל לאחיך לא תשיך. על כן המלוה ברבית כאלו כופר באלהי ישראל כשארז"ל.
segments.en:
Siman 87 and on — Basar b'Chalav: Meat with Milk
סִימָן פ״ז וְכוּ׳ — בָּשָׂר בְּחָלָב

[§1]
The laws of basar b'chalav [meat with milk] — etc. It is explained in the holy Zohar [Mishpatim 125] that through basar b'chalav one gives strength to the sitra achra to suckle from holiness — G-d forbid — etc. — see there. And from this it is self-evident that then the sitra achra has even more power to overpower. And also: through this it has more power to dress itself in mitzvos and deceive the person — and through this one becomes separated and distanced from holy wisdom and intellect and life-force — which is the essential aspect of the tzelem Elokim [Divine Image] that illuminates the face of man — the aspect of: "a man's wisdom illuminates his face" — as explained in Siman 57. And therefore it is explained in the holy Zohar there: that through basar b'chalav the tzelem Elokim departs from him. And see in the Tikkunim, Tikkun 14 — where it is explained that the prohibition of basar b'chalav is in the aspect of: *"you shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together"* [Devarim 22:10]. And there in Tikkun 10 of the later Tikkunim it is explained: ox and donkey are the aspect of the klippos of Esav and Yishmael — which are the totality of the kingdoms of the sitra achra — as stated. And this: the prohibition of basar b'chalav is juxtaposed in Parshas Mishpatim and in Parshas Yisro to the mitzvah of bikkurim — for this mitzvah is from the side of the holiness of holy intellect and wisdom — the aspect of the birthright. And in Parshas Reeh this mitzvah is juxtaposed to the mitzvah of maaser — which is from the aspect of Malchus — as is known.

segments.he: מאחר שפוגם בבחי' התיקונים שצריך איש הישראלי לדבק בהם בכדי להתקרב אליו ית' ולהכיר אותו יתברך עי"ז כנ"ל: וע,Fאסור גם רבית מוקדמת ומאוחרת. כי ע"י רבית פוגם בבחינת חכמה ומלכות שהם בחינת אחור וקדם כידוע.
segments.en:
[§2]
For through basar b'chalav one damages the aspect of drawing these rectifications. And therefore: when the angels prosecuted against the receiving of the Torah — through which one merits the aspect of these rectifications — the Holy One, blessed be He, replied to them: "did you not eat meat with milk at Avraham's home?" — as stated. For through this one damages the aspect of drawing these rectifications. And therefore the Torah was strict regarding basar b'chalav only concerning the meat of cattle specifically — in which is the essential hold of the spirit of folly — the aspect of Esav — only that Israel rectify it through shechitah — etc. — as stated. And therefore it requires shechitah of both signs — and its blood does not require covering — and its fat is forbidden — as stated. But the meat of a chayah — in which the light of holy life-force shines more — therefore its fat is permitted — and its blood requires covering. And all the more so fowl — which requires only one sign — therefore there is no biblical prohibition of basar b'chalav with it. But even so it is also rabbinically forbidden.

[§3]
And therefore holy Torah expressed this prohibition in the language: "you shall not cook a kid in its mother's milk" — even though gedi [kid] includes all cattle. And this is because in the kid there is an extra hold for the aspect of Esav the hairy man. And therefore it is said of Yaakov: "and the skins of the kids of the goats she placed on his hands" — etc. — and it is said afterwards: "and he did not recognize him for his hands were like the hands of Esav his brother — hairy." And see in the holy Zohar what is explained regarding the kids of the goats — and why even so they are permitted for Israel's eating. And therefore the Torah alluded: since in the meat of cattle — the aspect of gedi — there is an extra hold for the aspect of Esav — but Israel rectify it through the mitzvos of shechitah and nikur [removal of forbidden fat and sinews] and salting — therefore: if one cooks it in cattle milk — which was drawn and clarified from its blood — in the aspect of the blood becoming congealed and becoming milk — and it became so clarified of itself through the supernal power coming upon it from above — whose root is from the aspect of supernal whiteness — the aspect of wisdom and thought — through which all holy clarifications — in the aspect of: kulhu b'machshavah isbariru [all are clarified through thought] — and from there the redness of the blood — in which the sitra achra of Esav the red one has seized — was sweetened until it was turned into whiteness — the whiteness of milk — until it became permitted for Israel's eating without any rectification at all. And this is the aspect of: *"and enough milk of goats for your bread — etc. — and life for your maidens"* [Mishlei 27:27] — for it is from the aspect of wisdom and life — as stated.

segments.he: וע"F גם רבית דברים אסורים כי הדיבור כלול גם כן משני הבחינות הנ"ל. וזה שאמרו רז"ל (בבא מציעא דף ס"א) הקשו מלוי ברבית לשופכי דמים כי לא די שא ינו ממשיך חיות להלוה בבחי' וחי אחיך עמך אדרבא יונק ממנו תמצית חיותו ביותר ע"י הרבית. וזה שארז"ל (שם דף ע"א) בא וראה סמיות עינים של מלוי ברבית. סמיות עינים דייקא. היפוך מה שצריכין להסתכל בעינא פקיחא על השכל והחכמה דקדושה. וזה אדם קורא לחבירו רשע יורד עמו לחייו, כי רשע הוא מסטרא דמותא היפוך בחי' החיים דקדושה. וזה מביא עדים וכו' וכותב וחותם פלוני כפר באלהי ישראל היינו כנ"ל. וזה שאמרו (שם דף ע"ה) ולא עוד אלא שמשימין משה רבינו חכם ותורתו אמת וכו'. היינו שפוגמין בבחי' משה שהוא בחי' שמש בחי' הדעת והחכמה דקדושה ופוגמין בבחי' התורה שעל ידה נותנין כח להמלכות דקדושה עד שנעשה בחי' אור הלבנה כאור החמה כנ"ל. ול כן ארז,ל (במ"ר פ' משפטים) כל מי שנוטל רבית מעלה עליו הכתוב כאלו עשה כל הרעות והעבירות שבעולם וכו' והקב"ה אומר עד עכשיו הוא חי. היינו כנ"ל. כי פוגם בזסה בכלל תיקוני התורה הק' שעל ידה זוכין לחיות דקדושה. ומי שמלוה בלא רבית כאלו עשה כל המצוות כי זה בחינת כלל כל מצוות התורה הקדושה להמשיך על ידם בחינת התיקונים הנ"ל. ועל כן ארז"ל שקולה צדקה כנגד כל התורה והמצוות וג"ח גדולה מן הצדקה עיין שם עוד במדרש הנ"ל ותבין לענינינו
segments.en:
[§4]
Therefore: if one cooks in it meat of cattle — in which the sitra achra of Esav has greatly seized — through this one gives it room to overpower even more — G-d forbid. And therefore the Torah was strict specifically in the manner of cooking — for through cooking the flavors of one and the other blend together even more — until they are completely included together and become one — and through this it has the power to suckle and overpower even more. And therefore the cooking itself is also forbidden. And its prohibition is so severe — to the point that it is also forbidden for any benefit — for even the benefit alone that the person receives from it greatly damages his soul — for through this the aspect of Esav — who is forbidden for all benefit — seizes upon him. For all the good of the wicked is evil for the righteous — as understood also regarding Yaakov our father when Esav said to him: "let me place" — etc. And therefore it only applies to the meat of a pure animal in pure milk — where both are permitted. And even meat of neveilah or forbidden fat — even so — at minimum they are of a permitted species.

segments.he: סימן קע"ח
segments.en:
[§5]
But if the meat or milk is of an impure species — then there is no prohibition of basar b'chalav regarding cooking and benefit — since it is forbidden anyway from the beginning of its creation — the sitra achra no longer has room to suckle from holiness through this. And therefore: fish and locusts — which require no shechitah at all — are permitted with milk — even rabbinically. But even so — biblically it is only forbidden through the manner of cooking — and specifically meat of cattle in cattle milk.

[§6]
Even so: our Sages forbade even placing cheese on the table together with meat — even meat of a chayah or fowl — since one may come to eat them together — and give the sitra achra a hold to seize. And not only that — but even if one has already eaten meat — one must not eat cheese afterwards — etc. — as explained in the Shulchan Aruch. For since the sitra achra has some hold in it — one must be concerned also regarding what one eats afterwards — since it draws its flavor even more — or there may remain some between the teeth. But if one ate the cheese first — one need not be concerned about what one eats meat afterwards — provided through rinsing and washing — and see in the Shulchan Aruch. And therefore: basar b'chalav does not apply biblically with the milk of a slaughtered or dead animal. For our Sages taught [Bechoros 6b] — regarding the permission of milk — it is an innovation [chiddush] — since it resembles a limb from a living animal yet the Torah permitted it. And therefore one may say: specifically with milk from a living animal — whose permission itself is an innovation — therefore if one cooks meat in it — the sitra achra is aroused to suckle from this — as stated. But not so with the milk of a slaughtered animal — whose permission is not such an innovation. And likewise with milk of a dead animal — which has departed from the prohibition of a limb from a living animal — and even though it is now forbidden because of neveilah — it is in truth forbidden — and the sitra achra has no room to suckle from this. And even according to those who hold that milk of neveilah has no biblical prohibition of neveilah — one may say they hold: even so the prohibition of a limb from a living animal has departed from it — and therefore it is not such an innovation — since it is milk of a dead animal. (And see this matter in the legal authorities.) But even so: even with the milk of a slaughtered animal — it is rabbinically forbidden. And see Siman 30 regarding the law of kechal [udder].

segments.he: שלא ללבוש במלבושי עכו"ם. כי המלבושים הם בבחינת מלכות ונמשכין בשרשם מבחי' החכמה העליונה כמבואר כבר כ"פ ועי' בהמעשה של הבנים שנחלפו מענין המלבוש שעושה החמה ללבנה שזה בחינת חדתותי דסיהרא ומבחינה זו שורש בחינת המלבושים של ישראל הדבקים בבחינה הנ"ל. אבהל מלבושי עכו"ם וכל מנהגיהם נמשכין מבחי' חמה ולבנה דסט"א. וע,F אסור לילך בחוקותיהם:
segments.en:
Siman 91 and on — Meat and Cheese that Touched
סִימָן צ״א וְכוּ׳

[§1]
Meat and cheese that touched each other are permitted — but one must wash — etc. — for since they touched only while cold — one need only be concerned about what adhered visibly — and washing suffices. And likewise regarding the person: if something not good — G-d forbid — merely touched his heart and thought — if it was only incidentally — and he did not deepen it in the warmth of the inclination — but only in a cold manner — it suffices for him to wash — to purify his heart with the pure waters of Torah and holy intellect. But initially one certainly must guard oneself even from such an aspect — lest one eat it without washing — perhaps one will not immediately place one's heart to wash and purify one's heart from all the dross that adheres to it even while cold — and one's service will be found mixed with dross — G-d forbid.

segments.he: סימן קע"ט
segments.en:
[§2]
And all of this is while cold. But while hot — even if only the milk is hot — and cold meat fell into it — etc. — everything is forbidden — for tata'ah gabar [the lower one prevails] — for the lower one heats the upper — or cools it — according to what the lower is — whether hot or cold. For everything depends on the lower ones — for b'itarusa d'letata isitar le'eilah [through arousal from below comes arousal from above]. And likewise regarding our matter: wisdom and intellect is the aspect of the higher level — the aspect of head and firstness — and it is written: "the path of life is upward for the wise" [Mishlei 15:24] — etc. And Malchus is the aspect of the lower level — for it is the aspect of sof davar. And therefore it is said of it: "this is Jerusalem — which I have placed in the midst of the nations" [Yechezkel 5:5] — etc. — and therefore there is the essential battle — as understood also within. And therefore everything depends according to the aspect of the lower: if it is hot — meaning: the fierce boiling of judgments has prevailed in it — then even if the lower is permitted and into it fell forbidden that is cold — everything becomes forbidden. And if the lower is cold — even if it is forbidden — and into it fell permitted that is hot — and it forbids if the impure is salted. For salt alludes to the aspect of intellect — as explained above in Orach Chaim — and therefore: if the impure is salted and dresses itself in some aspect of intellect — therefore even the permitted is also forbidden.

[§3]
And see in the Shulchan Aruch the particulars therein. And this is the aspect of nullification of the prohibition in sixty. For all mixture of a prohibition in something permitted is the aspect of damage to holy Malchus — the aspect of nun. And our Sages taught: why is the letter nun not written in Ashrei — because it contains a falling — etc. — and even so David returned and supported it through the holy spirit — as it is said: "Hashem supports all the fallen" [Tehillim 145:14]. And therefore: if there are sixty times the amount of permitted — this alludes to the strengthening and support that holiness has — through the aspect of the samech [60] — the aspect of: "sixty are the queens" [Shir HaShirim 6:8]. And see in the discourse Heichal HaKodesh, Siman 59.

segments.he: שלא לכשף ולעונן ולנחש וכו'. כי אנחנו צריכין לקשר עצמינו רק אל אור השכל דקדושה שיש בכל דבר כנ"ל לכן צריכין לילך בתמימות ולבלי לחקור אחר העתידות ולקבל הכל באהבה ובתמימות ואז נהיה לו ולחלקו כמו שפירש"י על פסוק תמים תהיה עם ה' אלהיך הינו כנ"ל כי מאחר שעיקר מטרת כוונתינו הוא רק להתקרב אליו יח' ע"י כל דבר א"כ איך אפשר לנו להשתדל בתחבולות ולחקור עתידות בפרט ע"י תחבולות רשע של כישוף וכיוצא רק צריכין לקבל הכל באהבה ולקשר עצמינו אל השי"ת בכל מה שעובר עלינו כי רק הוא ית' חלקינו ונועם גורלינו.
segments.en:
[§4]
And therefore: we do not say chaticha na'asis neveilah [the piece becomes like a carcass] except regarding basar b'chalav — which is the body of the prohibition itself — and is from the aspect of the sitra achra — the aspect of neveilah — the opposite of the holy moon. But if the piece absorbed from other prohibitions — we do not say chaticha na'asis neveilah biblically — by all opinions. For since the body of the piece is permitted — it is from the side of holiness — only that it became mixed with the prohibition — and therefore it is now in the aspect of falling and becomes forbidden. But even so: it still has hope to rise from its fall — through the aspect of the samech — meaning: when permitted is added upon it until the prohibition becomes nullified in sixty — the aspect of: "Hashem supports all the fallen." And therefore one does not nullify a prohibition initially — only when permitted is added automatically without the intention to nullify. For this is the aspect of what our Sages taught: "it has fallen and shall not rise again by itself" — but rather the Holy One, blessed be He, Himself will raise it — as it were — the aspect of: "I will raise up the fallen Tabernacle of David" [Amos 9:11]. And likewise regarding this: when one intends to add permitted to nullify the prohibition — it is as if — as it were — the aspect of holiness — the aspect of Knesses Yisrael — rises by itself to nullify the prohibition. But when it is added automatically — this is heavenly assistance — the providence of Hashem — the aspect of: "Hashem supports" — (Himself as it were) — "all the fallen" — to raise them — the aspect of "I will raise up the fallen Tabernacle of David" — as stated. Even though the essential fullness is specifically through arousal from below — as is known — meaning: through our arousal from below — Hashem Himself is aroused — as it were — to raise us. (And there is no room to elaborate further here.)

segments.he: וע"כ באמת נארמ אצל יעקב שזכה לבחי' אור השכל הנ"ל ויעקב איש תם וכמובא במאמר הנ"ל על פסוק אשרי תמימי דרך. ועל כן גם אחיזת עינים אסור. כי פוגם בזה בבחי' עינים דקדושה וזה בחי' איסור דורש אל המתים. יכ מדבק עצמו עי"ז לבחי' סטרא דמותא היפוך בחי' החיים דקדושה.
segments.en:
Siman 98 and on — Laws of Mixtures
סִימָן צ״ח וְכוּ׳ — הִלְכוֹת תַּעֲרֻבוֹת

[§1]
The laws of mixtures. And therefore specifically in a different species — where the taste of the prohibition is recognizable and perceived — sixty is needed to nullify it. For then presumably the taste of the prohibition is already nullified and no longer perceived. And therefore: anything whose taste matters — even in a thousand it is not nullified — since the taste of the prohibition is still perceived. And the matter of taste in every thing — it flows at its root from the aspect of intellect and daas — as cited above in Orach Chaim. And therefore: as long as the taste of the prohibition — which is from the aspect of the sitra achra — is still perceived — it is forbidden. But if the prohibition is from the Torah — through the majority — since the majority is from the side of holiness — therefore the prohibition is nullified through the majority — for biblically we follow the majority. And therefore a person is judged according to his majority — and so the world — as our Sages taught. But even so rabbinically — sixty is needed even in the same species in liquid with liquid.

segments.he: וזה בחי' בעד החים אל המתים וזה שמובא בזוה"ק שאני הני דאיקרון חיים. וע"כ אסור להתרפאות בדברי תורה אם לא משום פיקוח נפש. כי כיון שכבר נפגע ועבר עליו בחי' שליטת הסט"א שמשם שורש כל הסירוים וחולאים ר"ל שכל זה בא על ידי ביטול תורה כמו שארז,ל יתלה בביטול תורה וע,כ איך אפשר לו לקבל רפואה על ידי סגולת אמירת דברי תורה לבד שיאמר על המכה רק צריך לשוב תחלה בתשובה שלימה על מעשיו ויקבל עליו עול תורה באמת ואז ממילא יקבל רפואה כ"ש ושב ורפא לו וכתיב רפאות תהי לשריך וכו' וכשארז"ל. וע,כ להגן עליו מן המזיקין שלא יפגעו בו מותר לקרות פסוקים. כי בוודאי על ידי ד"ת מגרשין הסט"א כמו שארז"ל כל העוסק בד"ת מזיקין בדלין ממנו וזה כיכל הגוים וכו' אל מעוננים ואל קוסמים ישמעו ואתה לא כן נתן לך וכו' נביא וכו' כמוני יקים לך וכו' ונתתי דברי בפניו וכו'. כי הקב"ה מודיע עתידות לישראל ע"י ניבאיו הק' שמקבלין כחם מבחינת משה רבינו ששרשו בבחי' החכמה העליונה בחי'פני משה כפני חמה שזה בחי' ונביא לבב חכמה כעין שדרשו רז"ל:
segments.en:
[§2]
And therefore: prohibited matters also combine to nullify one another — if they are different in taste — as explained in Siman 98, paragraph 9. To indicate: the sitra achra is not an independent authority — G-d forbid — but they too receive life-force from Him — as elaborated in his teachings in many places. And therefore: when Hashem wants to subdue the sitra achra — sometimes He subdues it from itself — mineih uveih ava lizol beih narga [from it and by it the axe goes into it] — as we find: the fall of Vashti through Haman — and the completion of Haman's fall through Charvonah. And similarly many more. And this touches somewhat also on what our Sages taught: "great is a transgression performed for its own sake" — etc. — for even though the transgression itself is certainly from the aspect of the sitra achra — even so: when one's intention is truly for the sake of Heaven — sometimes the sitra achra is subdued through this specifically. But because of the great danger — one must certainly be extremely careful about such a thing. And likewise: sometimes one must use the quality of anger and cruelty to take vengeance against the wicked — and many more similar things. And it is self-evident in general from this: when Hashem wants to strengthen the power of holiness — He sometimes brings it support and reinforcement from the other side — in the aspect of: "and the evil angel is forced to say amen." And this is the aspect of what Haman's wise men and Zeresh his wife themselves told him: "if he is of the seed of the Jews — etc. — you shall surely fall before him." And likewise: Achashveirosh himself commanded that Haman be killed — and removed his ring from his hand — and gave it to Mordechai.

Siman 100 and on — Beryah; Things That Have No Nullification
סִימָן ק׳ וְכוּ׳

segments.he: סימן ק"פ
segments.en:
[§1]
And therefore: a beryah [whole creature] is not nullified — etc. — and it has the law of beryah only if it had life-force in it and was forbidden from the beginning of its creation. For since it was forbidden from the beginning of its creation — and never had a permitted moment — and it had life-force — from this it is self-evident that both it and its life-force are from the aspect of the sitra achra. And therefore — because of its power and importance — our Sages taught: it cannot be reversed to become permitted and move to the side of holiness — and even in a thousand it is not nullified. For every time one encounters the prohibition and eats it — one damages one's soul through it — since it was rooted in the aspect of the life-force of the sitra achra — which is the essential sitra d'mosa — the aspect of: "in their lives they are called dead" — as is known.

[§2]
And likewise: a piece that is worthy of being honored — since it is in the aspect of importance and honor — the aspect of Malchus and grace of the sitra achra — therefore it too is not nullified. And likewise: something that has a way to become permitted is not nullified in the same species. For until one eats it in the state of prohibition — one could eat it in the permitted state. And therefore: if one eats it in the time of its prohibition — even through nullification — one appears as if one has will and inclination toward the side of prohibition — since this very thing could be eaten in the permitted state.

segments.he: וע,כ אסור כתוב קעקע וקריחה על מת או לע"ז. כי זה מחוקות העכו"ם הדבוקים בסטרא דמותא בחי' ימותו ולא בחכמה ע"כ רושמין בגופם לשם זכרון המתים או הע"ז. אבל ישראל הדבקים באלהים חיים עד שגם במיתתן קרוים חיים ע"כ אסור להם כל זה. וזה בנים אתם וכו' לא תתגודדו וכו' כי מיתתם הוא רק כמו מי ששולח המלך אחר בנו לחזור לביתו לשלום להשתעשע עמו וכו' וכמו שדרשו רז"ל על זה
segments.en:
Siman 103 and on — Spoiled Taste; Hot and Cold
סִימָן ק״ג וְכוּ׳

segments.he: סימן קפ"א
segments.en:
[§1]
And therefore: anything whose taste is spoiled does not forbid its mixture. For since one derives no benefit from the taste of the prohibition — but on the contrary — therefore it is not considered a taste at all and cannot forbid the permitted. And therefore: a vessel that is not a ben yomo [used within the last 24 hours] is considered a spoiled taste. For since the taste of the prohibition is not visible — only absorbed and covered and hidden within the vessel — and since a full cycle of day and night has passed over it — which encompasses the aspect of day and night — sun and moon — the taste of the prohibition has already become spoiled and weakened — and it no longer has the power to forbid the permitted. And therefore: if the permitted is a sharp thing — we say: it makes it desirable again. For through the power of sharpness — whose root is from the aspect of judgments — the aspect of what our Sages taught about the school of Shammai: that they were sharper — through this the power of the taste of the prohibition is aroused and strengthened — whose root is from the aspect of the extension of judgments. And some say: overnight weakens the prohibition — the aspect of bas dina batel dina [when the judgment has passed — the judgment is nullified]. And therefore our Sages taught: soaked is like cooked. For since it was soaked within the prohibition — or the prohibition within it — for a full cycle of day and night — even though it is cold — since the prohibition is visibly present and pressed into something liquid for a full cycle which encompasses the aspects of sun and moon — therefore through the power of the aspects of sun and moon of the sitra achra — the taste of the prohibition is absorbed within it — as through cooking. And the matter of tata'ah gabar and maliyach k'rosei'ach [salted is like boiled] is somewhat explained above.

Siman 108 — Scent (Rei'ach)
סִימָן ק״ח

segments.he: איסור גילוח הפאות והזקן. עיין בכוונות. כי שערות הראש הם מבחי' גבורות ודינים. ועל כן צריכין לגלחם. כי מבחינת התגברות הדיינם ביותר יונק משם בחי' הסט"א בחי' עשו איש שעניר רק שצרייכן להשאיר הפאות שמרמזין לבחי' מלכות. היינו כי בנין בחינת המלכות שעל ידה זוכין לקבל מאור החכמה. היא מבחינת גבורות כידוע. שזה בחי' דינא דמלכותא. ע,כ אסור לגלח הפאו. ושערות הזקן הם בבחי' חסד ורחמים ששרשם מבחי' החכמה שזה בחי' זקן זה קנה חכמה בבחי' הדרת פנים בחי' חכמת אדם תאיר פניו וע"כ אסור לגלחן. גם שערות הזקן מרמזין לשלש עשרה מדות שהתורה נדרשת בהם בחי' עסק התורה הנ"ל. וכן מרמזין לשלש עשרה מדות של רחמים שהם שורש כלל בחי' התפלה, וע"כ אין ממנין שליח ציבור אא"כ נתמלא זקנו כמבואר בשו"ע או"ח סי' נ"ג. נמצא שבהפאות והזקן מרומזין כל התיקונים הנ"ל שהם בח'י כלל קדושת ישראל כנ"ל.
segments.en:
[§1]
And therefore: we say rei'ach [scent] is of no consequence after the fact — for the essential hold of the sitra achra and foolishness is only from the side of physicality and corporeality.
