segments.he: וע,כ צריך שתיהיה כל אות מוקפת גויל מארבע רוחותיה ושיהי בין אות לאות כחוט השערה. כי התורה נכתבה באש שחורה על גבי אש לבנה כשאר,ל וזה בחי' האותיות בדיו שחור על גויל לבן והנה השחרות מרמז על בחי' צמצום בחי' מלכות והלבנינות של הגויל מרמז על אור החכמה בח'י ונוזלים מן לבנון מן ליבונא דמוחא כידוע.
segments.en:
Siman 201 — Laws of Mikvaos
סִימָן ר״א

[§1]
The laws of mikvaos. See there the many distinctions in law between a spring and a mikveh of rainwater — and the like — and all is somewhat understood according to the above. For a spring is from the aspect of supernal Chochmah — as is known. And therefore it purifies even when the water is flowing. For it is in the aspect of: "a flowing spring — the source of wisdom" — from which the light goes and spreads to all levels — the aspect of: "let your springs spread outward" [Mishlei 5:16]. And therefore one can draw close to Hashem through every thing in the world — through the intellect that illuminates a person. For it is in the aspect of: "going and shining until the day is established" — the aspect of flowing water — that the waters go and flow even far from the place of their springing. But the mikveh is in the aspect of Malchus — which has nothing of its own — only what is influenced upon it from aspects and levels of holiness above its own — the aspect of rainwater and the like — that gather and are collected into the mikveh. And it is only in the aspect of measure and contraction — to receive the light and life-force through it. And therefore it purifies only through ashboron [still water] — that the water within it be gathered and collected — for it is from this aspect.

segments.he: והנה כל או תהוא מבחי' מלכות והוא בחי' צימצום ושיעור וגבול להמשיך על ידה אור החכמה העליונה בבחי' מדה וגבול וצמצום שזה בחי' שערות שמרמזין לשיעורא דאתוון דאורייתא וכמבואר במאמר מישרא סימן למד. וע"כ צריך שתהא האות מוקפת גויל לבן שמרמז לבחי' הארת החכמה (שהוא שורש האותיות שבכתב וחיותם) מכל רוחותיה. ושיהיה כחוט השערה לובן בין אות לאות. כחוט השערה לובן בין אות לאות. כחוט השערה דייקא כנ"ל. כי כל אות הוא בחי' שיעור בפני עצמו ויש לו שורש ויניקה בפני עצמו מאור בחי' הלובן העליון כנ"ל. וכן בין תיבה לתיבה שכל תיבה יש לו ענין ופירוש בפני עצמו וע"כ צריך להיות ביניהם הפרש ביותר שיהיו נראין כשתי תיבות. וע"כ ספר המנוקד פסול. כי נקודות הם מבחי' חכמה כידוע (עיין מאורי אור) וע"כ אין נקודות בתורה. כי פנימיות חכמת התורה א"א לגלות כלל כיהיא אין סוף כ"ש ארוכה מארץ מדה ורחבה מני ים וכו'
segments.en:
[§2]
(See Maurai Or.) And there is yet much to explain in this — and it is somewhat self-evident to the one who studies it.

segments.he: סימן רפ"ה וכו'
segments.en:
Siman 203 and on — Laws of Vows
סִימָן ר״ג וְכוּ׳ — הִלְכוֹת נְדָרִים

[§1]
The laws of vows. For when a person sees that his inclination has overpowered him — etc. — it is a commandment to take an oath or vow — in order to urge himself on — as our Sages taught. For through this one gives strength to holy Malchus to prevail over the kingdom of the sitra achra — the aspect of the yetzer hara — the aspect of Esav. For our Sages taught: one who vows — it is as if he vowed by the life of the King — the aspect of Chochmah — the aspect of: "wisdom gives life" — as stated.

segments.he: הלכות מזוזה. מצוות עשה לכתוב פ' שמע והיה אם שמוע ולקבעם על מזוזות הפתח וכו'. כי עיקר המשכת אור החכמה הוא בבחינת בית בחינת בחכמה יבנה בית כוו'. כי החכמה הוא בחי' פנימיות בחי' נקודה בהיכליה וכו' וחמת שא"א לזכות אל אור החכמה כ"א ע"י בחי' מלכות ועיקר כח המלכות הוא ע"י עסק התורה כנ"ל. ע"כ צריך לקבוע פרשת שמע שהוא קבלת עול מלכות שמים ופרשה והיה אם שמוע שיש בה קבלת עול תורה ומצות וקובעים אותם על מזוזת הפתח מימין הכניסה וימין מרמז לבחי' חכמה כנ"ל בכדי לרמז כי אי אפשר לכנוס ולבוא לבחי' פנימיות אור החכמה שהיא בחינת בית כי אם ע"י קבלת עול מלכות שמים ועול תורה ומצוות. ועיין זוה,ק ובכתבים שמזוזה בגימטריא אדני בחינת מלכות ובסגולתה לגרש הסט"א והיצה"ר היינו כנ"ל. וזה שמובא בזוה,ק שמזוזת אותיות זז מות. כי מגרש על ידה סטרא דמותא.
segments.en:
[§2]
And one who swears — it is as if he swore by the King Himself — who is the aspect of Ze'ir Anpin — the aspect of Torah — as is understood also in the holy Zohar and in the writings.

[§3]
And through the aspects of holy Chochmah and holy Torah — one gives strength to the yetzer tov — the aspect of holy Malchus — to prevail against the kingdom of the sitra achra. And therefore Yaakov our father — who merited the aspects of holy wisdom and intellect — was the head of those who vow — as it is written: "and Yaakov vowed a vow" [Bereishis 28:20] — and as our Sages taught. And therefore our Sages taught [Bereishis Rabbah, Parshas Vayishlach]: when Yaakov delayed his vow — the Holy One said to him: "Yaakov — fulfil your vow — arise and go up" — etc. — "and if you do not do so — you are like Esav." And what is Esav? — one who vows and does not fulfil — etc. And therefore one vows in time of distress — for all distresses and sufferings flow from the aspect of the deficiency and diminishment of the moon — the aspect of Malchus — G-d forbid. And through a vow one rectifies this — as stated. And this is what our Sages taught: "do not be accustomed to vowing" — for even though vows are in the aspect of: "let a person always arouse the yetzer tov against the yetzer hara" — for since one sees that one's inclination is scheming against one — to cause one to stumble — G-d forbid — one therefore fences against it and vows to separate oneself even from what is permitted — the aspect of: "vows are a fence for abstinence." And it is already explained: through this very act one has the power to prevail over one's inclination. Even so: sometimes they say to one: "is it not enough — what the Torah has forbidden?" — etc. — for sometimes one's inclination provokes one even more through this — until it causes one to transgress one's vow — G-d forbid. And sometimes this very thing itself is the counsel of the yetzer hara — whose way is to dress itself in mitzvos at first — as elaborated in the discourse mentioned. And likewise in this matter: it first incites one to perform the mitzvah and to vow — and its essential intention is to cause one to stumble afterwards to transgress the vow. And therefore the verse warned greatly about this: "better that you not vow than vow and not fulfil" [Koheles 5:4] — which apparently seems obvious — what is it telling us? — but the meaning is: one must contemplate one's ways greatly before vowing — for perhaps this very act is from the counsel of one's inclination — as stated. And therefore: a vow does not take effect until one articulates it with one's lips — and one's mouth and heart are equal. For speech is the aspect of Malchus-of-mouth — and through the vow one gives strength to holy Malchus — by drawing upon it the light of the supernal mochin — the aspect of: one's mouth and heart are equal — the aspect of: "the moonlight shall be as the sunlight" — as explained within. And therefore one follows the intention of the one who vowed — which is from the aspect of Chochmah and mochin — which is the essential root of the vow — as stated.

segments.he: ועל כן כל הזהיר בה יאריכו ימיו וכו' בבחינת החכמה תחיה וכו'. ועל כן כשאדם יוצא מביתו אז המזוזה בשמאלו. כי ע"פ רוב יוצא האדם מביתו בשביל לעשות מלאכה ומו"מ בבחי' שמח זבולון בצאתך וזה בחי' שמאל בחי' בשמאלה עושר וכבוד וע"F צריך אז בוודאי לקשר עצמו לקדושת הפרשיות שבמזוזה בכדי שיזכה עי"ז לקבל אור השכל הק' שיוכל ע"י להבין ולהשיג בחינת השכל והחכמה שיש בכל הדברים שבעולם אפילו בדברים חיצונים בכדי שיזכה להתקרב להשי"ת גם על ידםף.וע,כ אין הפתח חייב במזוזה אא"כ יש לו שני מזוזות ומשקוף. שמרמזין לג' אבות הקדושים כמבואר במ"ר פ' בא והם כלל בחי' המשכת תיקונים הנ"לף. וע"כ צרכין לקבעה בשליש העליון של גובה הפתח. כי גובה הפתח לא פחות מי' טפחים כנגד בחי' יו"ד ספירות הקדושים ושליש העליון נגד בחי' שלש ראשונות בחי' אור החכמה והמוחין הק':
segments.en:
[§4]
[Siman 228 and on:] And therefore: the annulment of vows is through a sage — who has acquired and mastered [gamil u'savir] — meaning: one who merited engagement in Torah — the aspect of ligmor — the aspect of: "let a person learn" — etc. — and also: savir — a reasoner and a man of intellect — the aspect of supernal Chochmah and intellect — as stated. And likewise: three who have mastered [d'gamiri lehu v'savri] may annul a vow. That they can at least receive some illumination of the intellect somewhat. And since they are three — the light of the holiness of Yaakov our father shines in them — who encompasses all three Patriarchs — the aspect of: "Yaakov — the rope of His inheritance" — as our Sages taught. And therefore they can annul the vow — whose root is there — as stated. And therefore: the annulment of vows is through charatah — regret — in which one regrets the essential vow from its beginning and root. And therefore: the sage or the three mentioned can ascend to its root — which is in the aspect of Chochmah — and annul it. And if one does not regret it from its root — one needs to seek a pesach [opening] — etc. — and the pesach is also from the aspect of Chochmah — the aspect of: "in wisdom He opens gates" — and also: the sefirah of Chochmah is vowel-pointed with patach — as is known. And therefore: one does not open [a vow through] something unforeseen [nolad]. For since the essential annulment is through the light of Chochmah — and our Sages taught: who is wise? — one who foresees the future [roeh es hanolad] — therefore one cannot annul it through: "I did not see the unforeseen" — which is the very opposite of Chochmah. For then one is only regretting from the unforeseen onwards — and not from the root. (And see within in the Shulchan Aruch on this.)

Siman 240 and on — Laws of Honoring Father and Mother
סִימָן ר״מ וְכוּ׳ — הִלְכוֹת כִּיבּוּד אָב וָאֵם

segments.he: סימן רצ"ב
segments.en:
[§1]
The laws of honoring father and mother. See Zohar Vayikra 12: it is written: "honor your father and your mother" — and it is written in the story of Creation: "let there be lights" — etc. — "these lights — this is the moon — and the sun is only the Holy One — etc. — and the moon is only the Assembly of Israel" — etc. It is explained for our subject: that man was created only for the honor of Hashem — meaning: to know and recognize Him — and draw close to Him. And this one merits through the aspect of the light of intellect — the aspect of the sun — the aspect of father in wisdom. And through the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of Knesses Yisrael — the aspect of mother — and the aspect of the moon. And therefore: one must also physically honor one's father and mother — who through them one came to this world. And presumably this was from Hashem's providence — for one's soul needed to come to this world specifically through them — so that one merit through this to come to one's eternal purpose — to draw close to Him. And also: they have a share in the matter of drawing one's mochin — for the son's brain comes from the father's brain — as understood also in the writings. And therefore one must honor them — in the aspect of: "the wise shall inherit honor." And therefore honor was juxtaposed to av [father] — who is the aspect of av b'chochmah [father in wisdom]. And for fear — the mother was placed first: "every man — his mother and his father you shall fear" [Vayikra 19:3] — for she is in the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of awe.

segments.he: הלכו תשילוח הקן. כי יקרא לפניך קן צפור בדרך וכו' ומבואר בדרז"ל שמרמז על הגלות בחינת כצפור נודדת מן קנה וכו' היינו בזמן הגלות והטלטול שאז בחי' התגברות המלכות דסט"א בחינת היצה"ר בחי' עשו שמבזה את הבכורה שהיא בחי' השכל דקדושה כנ"ל. גם כי ממילא ע"י הגלות עי"ז השכל והחכמה אינם מאירים בשלימות כמובן בדבריהם ז"ל (מגילה דף י"ב) ע"כ אז צריך ליזהר ביותר שיהיו מעשיו מרובןי מחכמתו ושתיהיה יראת חטאו קודמת לחכמתו. כי מחמת שדרך היצה"ר להתלבש במצוות ע"כ מתגבר אז דייקא (בעת בחינת קטנות השכל) לפתות את האדם לבקש ולחפש אז דייקא ביותר אחר השכל והחכמה וכל כוונת היצר הרע בזה בכדי להחליש דעתו ולבלבל אותו עי"ז ביותר. כי מאחר שהשכל עכשיו בקטנות ובהעלמה מחמת התגברות הגלות ע"כ ע"י שיהיהקשה לו להאדם להשיג אז אור השכל בשלימות עי"ז יתייאש עצמו לגמרי ויעזוב ויניח גם מעט הטוב שיוכל למצוא גם אז דהיינו עסק התורה וקיום המצוות ומעש"ט ולקבל עליו עו למלכות שמים שלימה שזה יוכל האדם לקיים בכל עת ובכל זמן. ועל כן הזהירה התורה ע"ז שאם ימצא קן צפור בדרך היינו בבחינת הגלות והטלטול.
segments.en:
[§2]
And this is the aspect of the great care in honoring one's father that Esav had — as our Sages taught — for he wanted to overpower through this specifically Yaakov — who is the aspect of holy intellect. And therefore in truth: "and Yaakov greatly feared" — and said: perhaps he comes to me through the merit of honoring father and mother — as our Sages taught [Bereishis Rabbah, Parshas Vayishlach] — as stated. But in truth all of this was only outwardly — and to deceive his father — while in his heart he was the exact opposite of all the above — as we find explicitly: he said: "let the days of mourning for my father draw near" [Bereishis 27:41] — and as our Sages taught — and it is said of him: "may the iniquity of his fathers be remembered" [Tehillim 109:14] — as our Sages taught. And also: the essential honoring of father and mother is that his name be honored and valued through one — through one's being righteous and a doer of good deeds. For this is the essential lasting honor. And as our Sages taught. But not through a violent wicked person like Esav — who on the contrary was a shame and disgrace to them — and whose essential honor was only through honoring them in material matters. But in spiritual matters — regarding the service of Hashem — which was the entire desire of Yitzchak and Rivkah — there he was on the contrary a cause of grief to them — as is explicitly stated in Scripture. And therefore our Sages taught in Tanna d'Bei Eliyahu, ch. 26: one who properly fulfils the mitzvah of honoring father and mother — no sin comes upon one — as stated. For since one gives through this even more strength to holy Malchus — the aspect of the yetzer tov — to prevail over the kingdom of the sitra achra — the klippa of Esav — the aspect of the yetzer hara — therefore one is automatically saved through this from all sins. And since the essential aspect of the rectification of Malchus — through which one merits the light of the mochin — is only through Torah study — therefore our Sages taught: Torah study is greater than honoring father and mother.

Siman 242 and on — Honoring One's Teacher and Torah Scholars
סִימָן רמ״ב וְכוּ׳

segments.he: והקן יהיה בכל מקום שיהיה וזה בכל עץ בחי' איזה לימוד מלימודי התורה שנקראת עץ חיים. או על הארץ היינו איזה מצוה שהירא מבחינת מלכות בחי' אץר וכן כל הענינים הכוללים בחי' תשוקת האמונה הק' שהיא בחינת ארץ בחינת שכן ארץ ורעה אמונה. וזה שמבאר אח"כ ביותר אפרוחים או ביצים מרמז ג"כ לשני בחינות הנ"ל וכמובן בזוה"ק אפרוחים מארי משנה או ביצים מארי מקרא. וזה והאם רובצת על האפרוחים וכו' כי באמת בוודאי חופף ומאיר עליהם אור החכמה דקדושה שהיא בחי' האם שלהם כי משם שרשם כידוע. ועל כן בא אז היצה"ר ומסיתו שידקדק דייקא ליקח האם שהיא בחינת השכל והחכמה, וכוונתו לבלבל עי"ז את הכל כנ"ל. וע"כ הזהירה התורה לא תקח האם על הבנים כי תכלית חכמה תשובה ומעשים טובים. וזה שלח תשלח את האם.
segments.en:
[§1]
The laws of honoring one's teacher and Torah scholars. A person is obligated in the honor and awe of one's teacher — more than of one's father.

[§2]
Meaning: because father and mother are in the aspect of distant causes for drawing these rectifications — as opposed to one's teacher — who is in the aspect of a close cause for this. For through studying Torah with him — one thereby merits to draw these rectifications in their fullness. And therefore one is obligated in his honor and awe — corresponding to the two aspects mentioned — the aspects of Chochmah and Malchus — as stated. And therefore: one who disputes with his teacher — it is as if he disputed with the Shechinah — etc. For since he brings one to know one's Creator and draw close to Him — therefore when one damages his honor — it is as if — G-d forbid — one damaged the honor of the Shechinah — as it were.

segments.he: שלא יבקש גדולות וחכמות רק ואת הבנים תקח לך שירבה בתורהו במעש"ט. ויש עוד בזה כי אע"פ שצריך איש הישראלי להסתכל רק בהשכל שיש בכל דברוכנ"ל אעפ"כ בשעת עבודה של תורה ומצוות צריך לסלק כל חכמתו ויעשה רצונו ית' רק בתמימות ופשיטות כעבד שעושה רצון קונו וכמבואר הרבה בזה בזוה,ק ובמאמר תקעו אמונה בליקות"נ סי' ה' כי זה התמימות דקדושה עולה על כל החכמות כמבואר במ,א. וע"כ יעקב דייקא שהוא בחי' השכל דקדושה נקרא איש תם כי זה עיקר שלימות השכל שישכיל שרחוק ממנו החכמה וכנ"ל כ"פ ובפרט בשעת תורה ועובדה צריכין בוודאי ליזהר בזה וע"כ הזהירה התורה גם כאן לא תיקח האם על הבנים שלא ישתמש בחכמתו והשגתו בשעת עסק התורה ועובדוה כי זה יהיה נראה כאלו השיג כבר שלימות החכמה שיש בכל זה ובאמת לא התחיל עדיין להשיג כלל כי מאד עמקו מחשבותיו ית'. ועל כן שלח תשלח את האם ואת הבנים תקח לך שיעשה הכל בתמימות ופשיטות שזה מבחי' מלכות בחי' צמצום השכל כנ"ל. וזה למען ייטב לך והארכת ימים שדייקא עי"ז זוכה לקבל אור השכל והחכמה שמשם שורש כל בחי' הטובה וכו' ואריכות ימיםך שבוע"ב ליום שכולו ארוך כשדרז"ל וזה שדרשו רז"ל פרט למזומן. היינו כי יש דברי עבודה וקדושה שכבר הם כאל ורשאי לחדד שכלו ולהתבונן בחכמתו עד היכן הדברים מגייעם בכדי לעשות אותם בכ"פ בחשק חדש לשא כמצוות אנשים מלומדה. וכן אם נטל הבנים והחזירם לקן וחזרה האם עליהם פטור מלשלח. כי מאחר שכבר זכה בהבנים וקיים כבר התורה ומצוות (שהם תולדות החכמה העליונה) בבחי' זו שלח תשלח את האם וכו' כנ"ל. ע"כ אחר"כ כשבאין לו המוחין מהארת החכמה שוב אין צריך לשלחם כי זה בחינת נעשה ונשמע בחי' עושי דברו והדר לשמוע בקול דברו. רק שצריך לחפש אח"כ אחר בחי' ומדריגת נעשה ונשמע גבוה עוד מזה וכמבואר במ"א וצריכין עוד לבאר בענין זה שבסימן זה הנ"ל:
segments.en:
[§3]
And therefore: it is forbidden for a student to rule on a halachah in front of his teacher. For the teacher and student are the aspects of sun and moon — as explained elsewhere. And the moon is in the aspect of having nothing of its own — only what it receives from the light of the sun — the aspect of supernal Chochmah — the aspect of the teacher. And therefore one must not rule on a halachah before him — for this shows as if one has some power and light of one's own — independently of one's teacher — who is against one in the aspect of the sun — the aspect of Chochmah. And therefore one is liable to death for this — through having separated from one's teacher's wisdom — the aspect of: "they shall die without wisdom." And therefore: it is forbidden for a student to call one's teacher by name. For: "what is His Name — this is Chochmah" — as cited in the holy Zohar. And when one calls one by name — one shows as if one has already attained the aspect of one's teacher's wisdom — which is the aspect of one's name. And this is a great damage — for the essential aspect of the student — the aspect of the moon — is to know that one has no attainment at all in one's teacher's wisdom — and to anticipate and hope each time to receive from afar some aspect of illumination and glimmer from the light of his wisdom. And through this specifically can one merit that the moonlight be as the sunlight — the aspect of what our Sages taught: Torah only endures in one who makes oneself as if one does not know — as it is said: *"and wisdom — from where shall it be found?"* [Iyov 28:12] — which is itself included in what is elaborated in the discourse mentioned — that because the light of the intellect is very great — one can only merit it through the aspect of nun — the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of the moon — etc. — as stated. And this is what our Sages taught: one who prevents one's student from serving one — it is as if one withholds from one kindness — whose root is in the aspect of Chochmah — as is known — and removes from one the fear of Heaven — the aspect of Malchus — as stated. And: every student who treats the honor of one's teacher lightly — causes the Shechinah to depart from Israel. For through this one causes the aspect of separation — G-d forbid — until one grows distant from Him. And therefore: one does not give honor to a student in front of his teacher — etc. — and likewise several other laws in Siman 242 — and all are explained according to the above.

[§4]
And therefore: Torah scholars are exempt from taxes and levies — and the like. And if one has merchandise — others sell one's merchandise first. And all of this — because through their Torah they give strength to holy Malchus to prevail against the kingdom of the sitra achra. And therefore our Sages taught: one who accepts upon oneself the yoke of Torah — removes from oneself the yoke of the kingdom and the yoke of worldly concerns. And therefore Torah scholars do not need a guard either — for Malchus itself — the aspect of shamor [guarding] — guards them. And therefore one must stand before every Torah scholar — and honor him — even a young sage. For since he merited wisdom — through which His honor is revealed — by knowing and recognizing Him through the intellect and wisdom in every thing — therefore one must honor him — for he is in the aspect of: "the wise shall inherit honor." And likewise: it is a commandment to stand before one who has reached seventy years of age. For even though there is in truth wondrous intellect in each and every thing and matter that passes upon a person — by the hundreds and thousands every single day — in fine particulars. But in general: every single day there is a wondrous intellect through which one must attain and recognize Him according to the aspect of that day. And this intellect is in the aspect of the encompassing intellect of that day — in which all the particular intellectual aspects clothed in every thing that passes upon one on that day are included. And this: *"blessed be Hashem each day"* [Tehillim 68:20] — and our Sages taught: each and every day — give one something from the quality of its blessings. (And see in the tale of the Seven Beggars.) But even the encompassing intellect of each day is the aspect of the particular intellect relative to the encompassing intellect that a person must attain in each year according to its aspect. And the encompassing intellect of the entire year is the aspect of the particular intellect relative to the intellect and attainment that a person must attain in the general days of one's life — which are seventy years. For the fullness of the attainment of knowledge and wisdom for each person according to one's aspect is through multiplying days and years — the aspect of: "five years old for Scripture — ten for Mishnah" — etc. And this is the aspect of: "teach us to count our days — and thus we shall acquire a heart of wisdom" [Tehillim 90:12] — and: "and great years shall make wisdom known" [Iyov 32:7].

segments.he: סימן רצ"ג
segments.en:
[§5]
And therefore: one who has lived out one's days — to be seventy years of age — even if one is an ordinary person — one must honor and stand before one. For the aspect of old age and length of days flows at its root from supernal Chochmah — which is the source of life and length of days — the aspect of: "in the aged is wisdom — and in length of days — understanding" [Iyov 12:12]. And this is the aspect of what our Sages taught [Kiddushin 33]: Rabbi Yochanan would stand before aged non-Jews — saying: "how many troubles have passed over them." For even through the troubles and events that pass upon non-Jews over many days and years — those possessed of holy intellect can also recognize and attain the wonders of the Creator — it emerges that even through this the honor of Heaven can be magnified. And this is the aspect of: "rise before the aged" [Vayikra 19:32] — the aspect of one who is seventy — the aspect of old age — which is from the aspect of the light of Chochmah — from which is the essential life and length of days — and: "the splendor of the face of an elder" — one who has acquired the wisdom of Torah — even a young sage.

segments.he: הלכות חדש. אסור לאכול חדש וכו' עד שיוקרב העומר וכו' והאידנא דלינא עומר אסור כל יום ט"ז וכו'. כי כברמבואר לעיל שענין הקרת העומר היה בשביל להמשיך בחי' תיקון הצמצומים של בחי' מלכות בכדי לזכות עי"ז לקבל אור השכל והמוחין הק' בהדרגת וכו' והנה ענין אכילת הלחם בפרט מחמשת המינים שסועד וזן את האדם הכל הוא רק מחמת שמלובש בהם ביותר בח'י התיקונים הנ"ל שעל ידם עיקר החיות דקדושה כנ"ל. ועל כן אסור לאכול מתבואה חדשה עד הקרבת העומר וגם עכשיו דליכא עומר אסור כל יום ט"ז שהוא יום ראשון של ספירת העומר שאז עוסקין ישראל להמשיך התיקונים הנ"ל ע"י מצוות ספירת העומר ועי"ז נתתקנת התבואה חדשה שתהיה ראויה לאכילת ישראל שיזכו להמשיך על ידי אכילתם בחי' התיקונים הנ"ל
segments.en:
[§6]
And this corresponds to the aspect of Torah study. And: "you shall fear your G-d" — this corresponds to the aspect of holy Malchus — where is the source of awe — the aspect of the awe of Malchus. And this: "I am Hashem." For through all of this His divinity is revealed — and one merits to know and recognize Him — and draw close to Him through every thing in the world — as stated.

Siman 245 and on — Laws of Teachers and Torah Study
סִימָן רמ״ה וְכוּ׳ — הִלְכוֹת מְלַמְּדִים וְתַלְמוּד תּוֹרָה

segments.he: סימן רצ"ד
segments.en:
[§1]
The laws of teachers and Torah study. The positive commandment upon each person to teach one's son Torah — etc. For the essential purpose of bearing children is b'gin d'yishtamodain leih — in the aspect of: "a father shall make known to the children Your truth" [Yeshayahu 38:19]. And since the essential acceptance of the yoke of Heavenly Kingship and the drawing of holy intellect — through which one merits to know and recognize Him — is only through Torah study — as stated — therefore one must teach one's son Torah. And if his son is wiser and more understanding than him — his son takes precedence in Torah study — for the essential thing is holy intellect. And therefore: it is a commandment to teach also one's son's son Torah — the aspect of Yaakov — who merited the light of holy intellect — and was the grandson of Avraham our father. And therefore: it is a commandment for every sage of Israel to teach students — for since one has merited the light of Chochmah — to the point of being called a sage — therefore one must illuminate from one's light of wisdom also to others. For this is the essential quality of light — that it shines and comes to others. And therefore: when the son of each Jew begins to speak — one teaches him the verse: "Torah commanded us — Moshe" [Devarim 33:4] — and the verse: "Hear O Israel" — etc. For through this one begins initiating him in Torah study — through which strength is given to holy Malchus — the aspect of: "Hear O Israel" — the aspect of acceptance of Heavenly Kingship. And therefore one assigns one teacher for twenty-five students — corresponding to the twenty-five letters of the verse Shema Yisrael. And therefore the value and greatness of the study of young schoolchildren is very great — since it is from the breath of the mouth in which there is no sin — the aspect of the pure breaths of holy Malchus. For in them there is not yet the hold of the vain breaths of the sitra achra — flowing from the side of the yetzer hara — the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra. And therefore their study is most precious — and the world is sustained through it. And therefore one does not teach Torah to an unworthy student — for since one's inclination has already overpowered one and one has followed its counsel — one can damage through one's Torah study even more — in the aspect of: "if one did not merit — it becomes a deadly poison" — G-d forbid. And therefore one must first return one to the right path — and draw one toward holiness — and then teach. And therefore: a person is obligated in Torah study all the days of one's life — until the day of one's death. For since the essential holy life-force — the aspect of the light of holy Chochmah — one merits through the aspect of Malchus — and the essential power of holy Malchus is through Torah study — therefore: whether poor or rich — in all that passes upon a person all the days of one's life — one is obligated to set fixed times for Torah. For in all that passes upon a person — one must only gaze at the inner intellect in all of this — and this one merits only through Torah study. And therefore one must be constantly fixed in Torah. And therefore a person must divide one's years in three: one third in Scripture — the aspect of the source and foundation of Torah — corresponding to the aspect of the source of holy intellect. One third in Mishnah — the Oral Torah — corresponding to the aspect of Malchus-of-mouth — and it is called the Oral Torah. And through it one can merit the light of the intellect in Scripture — for without the Oral Torah one cannot at all attain the true intention of the Torah — because of the great brilliance of the light in it. It is the aspect of the moon. And one third in Talmud — corresponding to the aspect of the light that the moon receives from the light of the sun — until the moonlight becomes as the sunlight — the aspect of Talmud — which explains the reasons of the Mishnah — and thoroughly combines and encompasses Oral Torah with Written Torah — through the thirteen principles by which the Torah is expounded — and the like. And therefore some say: through the Babylonian Talmud one fulfils one's obligation for everything — for it is the general totality of all. And therefore: it is forbidden to study external wisdoms — and all the more so those that incline toward heresy — G-d forbid — which are the yetzer hara — the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — G-d forbid. And therefore one may not wander in the orchard of other wisdoms — even casually — until after one has filled one's belly with Shas and the legal authorities — and is thoroughly expert in the entire Torah. For otherwise — when one enters those wisdoms — even permitted ones — the sitra achra that suckles from there can overpower one even more. And therefore: Torah study equals all the commandments — for through it one merits the aspects of these rectifications — which are the general totality of all.

[§2]
And therefore: a person does not learn the greater part of one's wisdom except at night. For because of the greatness of Chochmah — one can only merit it through the aspect of Malchus — which is the aspect of night. And therefore: all who study Torah at night — a thread of kindness is drawn upon them — whose root is in supernal Chochmah — as stated. And the thread of kindness is in the aspect of chen [grace] in the language of our Sages — for through this one merits holy grace — as elaborated in the discourse Ashrei mentioned. And therefore: when one finishes a tractate — it is a commandment to rejoice and make a feast. For the conclusion — the sof davar — is in the aspect of Malchus — the source of joy — and all aspects of meals of mitzvah and holy eating and drinking — as is known. And therefore one says then: hadran alach — etc. — da'atan alach — etc. Hadar corresponds to the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of: "glory and majesty of His kingdom" — and also the aspect of splendor and grace — the aspect of: "beauty and splendor — bestow upon him." Da'as corresponds to the light of daas and Chochmah. And some interpret hadran from the language of: "who desires [hadar] to return" — from the language of return [chazarah] — that one returned to one's learning. For since one has merited to finish the tractate — the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of sof davar — and through this very act one merits the light of Chochmah — the aspect of firstness — therefore one must immediately return to one's learning — to the beginning of the tractate. And even if one does not actually go back and study that tractate from the beginning immediately — even so one must at the end of the tractate — at least have one's mind and thought still firmly bound to the beginning of the tractate. And through this one joins the aspect of the moon with the sun — and merits holy grace — as stated. And this: "we shall not forget you" — etc. — "and you shall not forget us" — etc. — the aspect of connection and bond mentioned. L'ra b'alma hadein — v'lo b'alma d'atei — which is itself also the aspect of these rectifications — the aspects of holy Chochmah and holy Malchus. And likewise: the souls of Israel with holy Torah are also the aspect of the connection and union of these two aspects. And therefore one says this at the end of the tractate — in order to unite and strengthen the aspect of the holy connection and union in its fullness.

segments.he: הלכות ערלה. הנוטע כל עץ מאכל מונה לו שלשה שנים וכו'. כי מפגם אכילת עץ הדעת נאחז זוהמת היצה"ר בכל דבר וכבר נתבאר שזוהמת היצמה"ר נקראת ערלה. וע"F היצה"ר עצמו נקרא ג"כ ערל כמו שארז"ל וכלל בחי' היצה"ר הוא בח'י שלש קליפות טמאות שהם בחי' רוח סערה וענן גדול ואש מתלקחת והרביעית היא בחי' נגה שכלולה מטובו רע כידוע וכנ"ל כמה פעמים ועל כן גם כאן שלש שנים יהיה לכם ערלים ובשנה הרביעית יהיה כל פריו קדש הלולים לה' כי בבח'י נגה שם עיקר הבירור להפריש הרע ממנו ולעלות הטוב שבו אל הקדושה ועל כן ע" ישמכניעין את הרע שבשלש שני ערלה ומרחיקין אותו לגמרי עד שהכל אסור בהנאה לעולם עי"זיכולין אח"כ להעלות בחי' נגה ולקשרו אל הקדושה שזה בחינת מה שמעלין את הפירות אז לירושלים או שפודים אותם בממון ומעלה הפדיון לירושלים ואז נתתקן האילן בשלימות עד שאין בו אחיזת הרע כ,כ מזוהמת היצה"ר ואז הותר באכילה גם במקומו כ"ש ובשנה החמישית תאכלו את פריו להוסיפף לכם תבואתו. וזה שארז"ל לא דברה תורה אלא כנגד יצה"ר וכו' היינ וכי בזה מכניעין את בחי' אחיזת היהצ"ר עד שזוכין לעבוד את ה' בשני יצרין שגם האכילה ושתיה וכל דברי הרשות והיתר יהיה ג"כ בקדושה גדולה ע, ישגם היצה"ר נכנע להקדושה ואז יכולין להתקרב אליו ית' ולעבוד אותו ית' ע,י כל הדברים שבעולם כנ"ל:
segments.en:
Siman 247 and on — Laws of Charity
סִימָן רמ״ז וְכוּ׳ — הִלְכוֹת צְדָקָה

[§1]
The laws of charity. It is already explained above that charity is also the aspect of drawing these rectifications. For through a rich person having mercy on a poor person — the aspect of: "praiseworthy is one who considers the poor" — and bestowing upon him — through this: spiritually too — the light of Chochmah — the aspect of the sun — the aspect of wealth and generosity — is drawn to holy Malchus — the aspect of poverty and lowliness — the aspect of the poor wise man. Therefore: charity is called shemesh — "sun of righteousness" — for it is in the aspect of drawing the sunlight — the light of Chochmah — as stated. And therefore: Torah too — through which one also draws the light of Chochmah — is also called charity: "tzedakah da oraisa" [charity — that is Torah]. And therefore it is forbidden to avert one's eyes from charity — for one must gaze at all times with an open eye upon the light of the intellect in every thing. And therefore all who avert their eyes from it — it is as if one worshipped idolatry — for this is from the aspect of the sitra achra — the sitra d'mosa — G-d forbid. And therefore: charity saves from death — and adds life and length of days — and makes wealthy. For Chochmah is the essential life.

segments.he: סימן רצ"ה וכו'
segments.en:
[§2]
And the fullness of Malchus is in the aspect of holy wealth — as stated. And therefore: there are eight [ches] levels of charity — each greater than the one — as explained in Siman 249. And this corresponds to the light of Chochmah — which is the aspect of ches — as elaborated in the discourse within.

segments.he: הלכות כלאי אילן וזרעים וכו'. מבואר בזוה,ק כי ע"י כלאים מערב הכחות הנמשכין מלמעלה על כל מין ומין וכו' וזה מבחינת הסט"א והיצר הרע דאזיל בערבוביא ובעקימו וכו'. כי כבר מבואר שבכל דבר יש בחי' שכל שהוא בחי' החיות של הדבר ועי"ז השכל יכולין להתקרב אליו ית' ולהכיר אות וית' ע,י זה הדבר שבשביל זה נברא הכל. ועל כן אסור לערב המינים שלא כדרך ברייתן ולזרוע כלאים ולהרכיב אילנות מן אחד על חבירו כי עי"ז מערבב הכחות שלא כסדרן עד שקשה להשיג השכל והחיות דקדושה המלובש שבהם ולהתקרב עי,ז להשי,ת רק אדרבא עי"ז מתגבר היצה"ר והסט"א ביותר להפריד את האדם מבחי' החיות והשכל דקדושה. וע,F הקפידה התורה עוד ביותר על כלאי הכרם ועובר בשני לאוין והתבואה והגפנים אסורים בהנאה וצריכים שריפה. כי מחמת שהגפנים נמשכים בשרשם ממקום גבוה מאד כמו שאמר הגפן אשר בו ישמחו אלהים ואנשים על כן אם זורע שני מיני זרעים שהם כלאים ועירב הכחות עם עוד תערובות ממין גפן עי,ז נותן ביותר כח להסט"א להתגבר ח"ו. וזה גם כן בחינת איסור כלאי בהמהמ שאסור להרכיב מין על שאינו מינו וכן אסור להנהיגן ולמושכן זה עם זה. ועיין בזוה"ק מבואר כי שור וחמור מרמזין לקליפת עוש וישמעאל שהם כלל בחי' המלכות דסט"א כנ"ל. וזה ג,כ בחי' איסור כלאי בגדים של צמר ופשתים כי כשמתערבין הבחינות והאדם נהנה מזה ע"י שלובש ומתכסה עמהם או מציעה תחתיו עי"ז יכולים ביותר להתגבר עליו הסט"א והיצה"ר שהם ג"כ מבחי' התערובות והתרמורות וכבר מבורא לעיל כי המלבושים נמשכים בשרשם מבחי' אור החכמה העליונה בחינת עוטה אור כשלמה והם בעצמם בחי' מלכו תוע"כ הקפידה התורה עליהם שלא לערב הבחינות הרחקוות בכדי שלא ליתן מקום עי"ז לאחיזת הסט,א כנ"ל. וזה שמובא שמי שלובש שעטנז אין תפלתו מקובלת. כי צמר בשרשו מרמז לבחי' חסד ורחמים בחי' חכמה. ופשתים מרמז לבחי' גבורות שורש בחינת מלכות ושני בחינות אלו שהם בחי' חי"ת ובחי' נו"ן כשנתחברין ע"פ התורה הק' עי"ז התפלה מקובלת בבחי' דברי חכמים בנחת נשמעים המבפ"נ משא"כ כשמתחברין שלא ע,פ התורה רק בהיפך כי עובר על ידי זה על איסור תורהשאסרה שעטנז עי"ז אין התפלה מקובלת
segments.en:
[§3]
And therefore it is good to give a coin to the poor before prayer — for through this the prayer is accepted — as understood within. And therefore: charity collectors who have charitable funds in their hands — let them marry off poor orphan girls — etc. — for through this charity the holy union mentioned — achieved through charity — is most evident and visible. And therefore one allocates charity for the dead — and it benefits their souls. For through the rectification drawn through charity to holy Malchus — until it is elevated from the aspect of the hold of the sitra d'mosa — the aspect of: "her feet descend to death" — (and see also the discourse Vayiven, Siman 67) — through this: rectification flows also to the souls of the dead. And especially to those dead ones for whom charity is specifically allocated. But for a completely wicked person it does not help — as explained in the Shulchan Aruch — for the completely wicked are from the aspect of the sitra achra — the aspect of what is forbidden to teach Torah to an unworthy student — as stated.

[§4]
And therefore: one must not give charity to one who intentionally transgressed any one of the commandments stated in the Torah — as explained in Siman 251. And therefore: a woman who comes to marry and unite with her partner — the aspect of the union of nun and ches elaborated within — therefore one must not diminish for her less than fifty zuz — corresponding to the aspect of nun mentioned. And therefore: residents of the Land of Israel take precedence in charity over residents of outside the Land — for they are more encompassed in the aspect of holy Malchus — which is itself the aspect of the Land of Israel — as is known. And therefore it is especially a commandment to support Torah scholars — for through the study of their Torah they draw the aspects of these rectifications. And therefore: even through the charity given to them — these rectifications flow more fully. And therefore: the charity of redeeming captives is very great — more than all charities. For through this — the rectification is most evident to the eyes — in the actual act of performing the mitzvah itself. For one is redeeming a soul of Israel — the aspect of holy Malchus — from the hands of non-Jews — the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra. And this is the essential rectification of charity — as stated. And for a Torah scholar — and even only for a sharp student — one redeems him even for a great sum — for upon him depends the rectification of holy Malchus. And therefore: one does not accept charity from non-Jews — for through this they receive — G-d forbid — even more power. And therefore: a king or minister of non-Jews who sent charity — let it be given to poor non-Jews — etc.

segments.he: סימן ש"ה וכו'
segments.en:
[§5]
And therefore: a community may not impose taxes and levies from charitable funds. For honor comes through charity as is fitting — giving strength to holy Malchus. And through this one is freed from all taxes — which are the aspect of the opposite of this — as it is written: "and they placed over them tax officers" — etc.

Siman 260 and on — Laws of Milah
סִימָן ר״ס וְכוּ׳ — הִלְכוֹת מִילָה

segments.he: פדיון בכור אדם ובהמה ופטר חמור.
segments.en:
[§1]
The laws of circumcision. For the orlah [foreskin] alludes to the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — which is the aspect of the general totality of non-Jews — encompassed in the klippa of Esav and Yishmael — as is known. And therefore Israel must remove it. And therefore: the general strengthening of the yetzer hara — which introduces the spirit of folly into a person — is also called orlah: *"circumcise the foreskin of your heart"* [Devarim 10:16] — and the Targum translates: "remove the foolishness of your heart." And since the essential strengthening of the spirit of folly of the yetzer hara is in this desire — the aspect of what our Sages taught on the verse: "when his wife goes astray" — and as cited in the holy Zohar: the essential root of the evil inclination is to reveal nakedness — therefore: through cutting the orlah — one weakens and diminishes the power of the yetzer hara — and diminishes the desire for cohabitation — as cited in their teachings. And this is the aspect of the revealing of the crown [atara] — which is revealed through the circumcision. Meaning: the illumination of holy Malchus is revealed — the aspect of: "a worthy woman is the crown of her husband." And in the Kiddush Levanah [sanctification of the moon] one says: "that she should renew herself as a crown of glory." And through this one merits the light of intellect and holy mochin — until one merits to attain Hashem through every thing in the world. And this too is the aspect of the revealing of the crown — for the mochin are the essential crown — the aspect of: "and their crowns upon their heads" — said regarding the righteous in the future — as explained elsewhere. And this too is the aspect of what our Sages taught [Megillah 15b]: "in the future the Holy One will be a crown upon the head of every righteous person" — etc. And this is the aspect of what our Sages taught [Bamidbar Rabbah, Naso, ch. 12]: "this is the matter that Hashem commanded — perform" — regarding circumcision. "And the honor of Hashem shall appear to you" — and likewise: regarding Avraham — when he was circumcised — it is said: "and Hashem appeared to him" — etc. — as stated. For through this one merits the revelation of His divinity — that one shall attain His divinity through all things of the world. And this is the aspect of: *"and from my flesh I shall behold G-d"* [Iyov 19:26] — and as our Sages taught. And this is the aspect of: circumcision on the eighth — corresponding to the light of Chochmah — the aspect of ches — as stated. And therefore: one circumcises only by day — for the light of Chochmah is the aspect of the shining light that goes and shines until the day is established. And therefore: a sick person — the aspect of damage to the life-force — damage to Chochmah — as understood also in the writings on the verse: "Hashem will support him on the bed of illness" — therefore one does not circumcise him until he recovers.

[§2]
And one waits for him seven days from the moment of recovery — in order to draw upon him anew the light of holy life-force and Chochmah — the aspect of ches — as stated. And then one circumcises him. When does the above apply? — when a fever afflicted him — etc. — for this indicates that the aspect of the sun of the sitra achra has overpowered him. And this is the aspect of the yetzer hara being called cham — for from one's own heat the person becomes ill. And likewise in other bodily illnesses — where the damage has spread to the general life-force. But if he was ill only in one of his limbs — etc. — one circumcises him immediately after he recovers. But if his eyes pained him severely — that is like a bodily illness. For the eyes are named for wisdom — for one must always gaze with an open eye upon the light of wisdom in every thing — as stated. And this is the aspect of: "I have made a covenant with my eyes" [Iyov 31:1] — etc. And this is the aspect of the eye-lights alluded to in the letters mem-lamed of the word milah. And this is also the aspect of the ein chasadim [eye of kindness] — as cited in the kavanos — for the root of kindness is in Chochmah — as stated many times. And this too is the aspect of: chei-es lights — eight kindnesses — cited in the kavanos — the aspect of ches mentioned.

segments.he: עיין בהקדמת הזוה"ק שעל ידי פדיון בכור קונה לו חיים ופודה אותו מסטרא דמותא. ועייין זוהר בא דף מ"א מובן שם שבזה נפדה מתחות שולטנותא דיצה"ר וכו'. היינו כי כלל ישראל נקראים בני בכורי על שם בחינת השכל דקדושה שהוא בחינת בכורה וכמובן במאמר הנ"ל בפנים.
segments.en:
[§3]
(And the hidden matters are not our domain.) And this is the aspect of milah and peri'ah and metzitzah. Milah [the cut] corresponds to the aspect of nullifying the yetzer hara — when it incites a person to actual transgression — G-d forbid — which is the actual orlah. Peri'ah [the uncovering] corresponds to the way of the yetzer hara — to dress itself in mitzvos — and then one needs great alacrity and cleverness — not to listen to it. And even so: one should not leave and abandon the mitzvah because of this — but rather: distinguish and separate the good from the evil — and perform the mitzvah with such wisdom and intellect — that one not come through it to transgression as the yetzer hara desires and intends — G-d forbid. And this is the aspect of peri'ah — which exposes the membrane and splits it — and leaves it to cleave and be included in the flesh of the crown — and does not tear and cut it off entirely. The meaning is as above: one does this in such a manner that everything is encompassed in holiness — and no mishap or damage or stumbling emerges from it — G-d forbid. And therefore: one who performed the milah but not the peri'ah — it is as if one did not circumcise. For the yetzer hara can yet overpower one — G-d forbid — through this aspect — of dressing itself in mitzvos — to bring one to transgression — which is the aspect of complete orlah — G-d forbid.

segments.he: כי עיקר הולדת האדם הוא רק בשביל המשכת השכל הנ"ל וע"כ הבכור שהוא הולדה ראשונה ויש לו חלק בכל ההולדות הבאים אחריו כמובן בכתבים ועל כן מתגבר אז בחינת קליפת עשו שביזה את הבכורה כי הוא בחינת הסט"א והיצה"ר שמבזין את השכל דקדושה ומתגברין אז למנוע ולערב ההולדה ומזה נמשך ע"פ רוב עקישוי לידה שבהולדה ראשונה בחי' צרה כמבכבירה.
segments.en:
[§4]
And afterwards one sucks the blood [metzitzah] — and through this one completely subdues the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — the klippa of wicked Esav the red man of blood — completely — so that there be no hold on the soul of Israel even in potential. For sometimes one subdues the yetzer hara — so that it cannot actually overpower to bring to actual transgression — G-d forbid — even through the aspect of dressing itself in mitzvos — and even so there is a hold on it in the aspect of potential — G-d forbid. And then the person is not yet safe from it — for it lurks against one like a bear — to cause one to fall in its net each time — G-d forbid. And this hold — since it is only in the inner dimension alone — in the aspect of potential — as stated — is therefore not in the category of the orlah — and not in the category of the skin of the peri'ah — since it is not visible or recognizable at all. And it is only in the aspect of blood — where is the root of its hold in potential — G-d forbid. And therefore: one must suck it out well — until no blood remains except good and holy blood — in which there is no hold of evil at all — even in potential. And then the light of the crown is revealed — the aspect of drawing the light of these rectifications in their fullness. And therefore: one who is born circumcised also needs to draw a drop of covenant blood — in order to nullify from him even the aspect of the hold of evil in potential — as stated. And corresponding to these three aspects — one draws the aspects of three rectifications. For through cutting the orlah — the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — which grows strong to do complete evil in actual deed — G-d forbid — and when one cuts it — the aspect of holy Malchus is strengthened — for when this one rises that one falls — etc.

[§5]
And the rectification through Torah study is the aspect of the rectification drawn through peri'ah — through which one distinguishes good from evil — and the evil falls — and the good remains in its fullness. And this is what our Sages taught: "all that the Merciful One forbids — He permits for us an equivalent." Meaning: through this one clarifies the good even from the aspect of evil — as stated. And through subduing the evil also at its root — in the aspect of potential — which is the aspect of metzitzah — through this one merits the revelation of the light of supernal Chochmah — which is in the aspect of potential — as is known — the aspect of: Chochmah — the letters koach mah [power of mah] — as cited. And this is the aspect of what is said in the verse: "praiseworthy is one whom You choose and draw near to dwell in Your courtyards" [Tehillim 65:5] — this corresponds to holy Malchus — the aspect of chatzros Hashem. "We shall be satisfied with the goodness of Your house" — this corresponds to Torah — for "there is no good except Torah." And it is the aspect of: the House of Bereishis. "Your holy Sanctuary" — this corresponds to the light of Chochmah — called holy — as is known — and is the essential inner dimension — the aspect of: "a point within his sanctuary." And see the holy Zohar. And everything converges to one place. And therefore after the circumcision one blesses over wine — which alludes to Malchus and likewise to Chochmah — as stated many times. And therefore one prays then for the life and survival of the infant — for through these rectifications the prayer is accepted. And therefore one gives then the Israelite name to the infant — for a name alludes also to the aspects of these rectifications — and the name is the root of all the names of the children of Israel. And this is what is said: "just as he has entered the covenant — so may he enter Torah." This corresponds to Torah study — through which is the essential drawing of these rectifications. And this: "and to the wedding canopy" — this corresponds to the aspect of the source of supernal Chochmah — from which the light of the sun goes and shines — the aspect of: "and he is as a groom going out from his canopy" [Tehillim 19:6] — as understood in the holy Zohar. And: "and to good deeds" — this corresponds to holy Malchus — nestled in the world of action — as is known. And this: *"and I said to you: in your blood — live"* [Yechezkel 16:6] — for through the blood of circumcision one merits the drawing of these rectifications — which are the essential aspect of life — as stated. And this is the aspect of the chashmal cited in the kavanos and in the holy Zohar — for our Sages taught: chashmal is from the language of chash [silence] and mal [speech] — the aspect of the general totality of these rectifications. For Chochmah is the aspect of chash — the aspect of: "silence is a fence for wisdom." Mal is from the aspect of Malchus-of-mouth — the aspect of speech. And therefore: the orlah and the blood of metzitzah are placed in earth — the aspect of what our Sages taught regarding subduing the yetzer hara: let one recall the day of death — the aspect of: "for you are dust and to dust you shall return." And also: earth alludes to holy Malchus — as is known. And this is the aspect of: "all was from the dust" — and our Sages taught: even the globe of the sun — for one cannot merit the light of the intellect — the aspect of the sun — except through the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of dust — as stated. And therefore the custom is to make a chair for Eliyahu — and it is explained in Siddur Kol Yaakov that this is because he is of the aspect of Malchus — etc. — as stated — for through him Heavenly Kingship was so greatly revealed: "and all the people saw — etc. — and they said: Hashem — He is G-d" — etc. And therefore: when the time of the coming of Mashiach arrives — when His Kingdom is fully revealed — in the aspect of: "and saviors shall ascend Mount Zion to judge the mountain of Esav — and the Kingdom shall be Hashem's" [Ovadyah 1:21] — therefore Eliyahu will come first to announce this — for it is from his aspect. And therefore one must say with one's mouth that it is the chair of Eliyahu — for Malchus — etc. And this is the aspect of the sanctity of the sandak — who is like ketores [incense]. Meaning: since upon his knees is the mitzvah of circumcision performed — through which is the essential subduing of the yetzer hara — therefore he is in the aspect of ketores — as explained in the holy Zohar, part 2, 218b: "since the breaking of the yetzer hara is certainly from all sides through the ketores — etc. — there is nothing in the world to break the sitra achra like ketores" — etc. — and it concludes: "and one is saved from all judgments — and from the judgment of the other kingdom." And see further on this in Zohar Chadash, Shir HaShirim, 80b. And therefore: the woman brings the infant to the synagogue — since she is of the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of: "a woman who fears Hashem." And therefore the mohalim [circumcisers] customarily pray on the day of circumcision — for through this the prayer is accepted. And therefore the sandak and the mohel go up to the Torah. For the essential drawing of these rectifications is through Torah. And the reason the sandak precedes the mohel — see the reason in the latter-day legal authorities. And therefore a feast is made on the day of circumcision — for through the drawing of these rectifications — through this is the essential rectification of the meal — as stated many times. And therefore circumcision overrides tzara'as. For through it the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — called tzara'as and baheres and nega — is pushed away. And therefore one cuts it together with the orlah — for it is one aspect with it. And therefore: circumcision overrides Shabbos — for through it one draws the light of supernal Chochmah — which is the root of the holiness of Shabbos — the aspect of: "for it is holy" — as is known. And this is what our Sages taught [Nedarim 31b]: "I vow to have no benefit from uncircumcised ones" — forbidden even from circumcised non-Jews — for they are the essential aspect of orlah. And this is what they said there: "the foreskin is repulsive — for the wicked are disgraced through it" — etc. — for from there comes all wickedness — and it is repulsive and shameful — the opposite of holy grace — as explained within. And this: "great is circumcision — for thirteen covenants were made regarding it" — corresponding to the thirteen principles by which the Torah is expounded — the general totality of Torah discourses. And corresponding to the thirteen attributes of mercy — the aspect of the general totality of prayer. "Great is circumcision — for it overrides Shabbos" — as stated. "Great is circumcision — that Moshe was not spared for it" — etc. — and even though he himself is the aspect of the sun — the aspect of Chochmah. "Great is circumcision — that none of the commandments that Avraham our father performed made him complete — until he circumcised himself." For sometimes the yetzer hara also dresses in mitzvos — and therefore the essential fullness of the mitzvos is when one completely subdues the yetzer hara. And also: through this one merits the light of Chochmah — the essential fullness — the aspect of: "if you acquired daas — what do you lack?" And this is the explanation of: "walk before Me and be wholesome" [Bereishis 17:1] — meaning: may you merit the light of holy intellect — the aspect of Yaakov the wholesome man — as explained within. Alternative explanation: "great is circumcision — for were it not for it — the Holy One would not have created His world." For the essential creation of the world was b'gin d'yishtamodain leih — and to this one cannot merit except through the mitzvah of circumcision — as stated. And see there further [32b, 267]: The laws of slaves. It is a positive commandment for the master to circumcise his slaves — etc. For even though they were born from non-Jews — who are from the aspect of the yetzer hara — the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — the aspect of orlah — even so: since they were sold to an Israelite and entered under his authority — who is of the aspect of the yetzer tov — holy Malchus — therefore one must circumcise them — and cut their orlah — in order to remove from them the filth of the yetzer hara — the kingdom of the sitra achra. And there are distinctions in law between a yeled bais [home-born slave] — circumcised on the eighth — for one can draw upon him the glimmer from the aspect of the light of ches mentioned. And a miknath kesef [purchased slave] — circumcised on the day he was acquired — for one only needs to cut his orlah in order to encompass him somewhat in holy Malchus. And there are details in this in the Shulchan Aruch — and all is explained according to the above. And therefore one informs him of the essentials of the religion — etc. — and in the presence of three one converts him somewhat — in order to draw upon him the aspect of the waters of holy daas — through which one merits to know Him — even so he does not yet have the full status of Israel — and is obligated only in commandments in which women are obligated. And therefore: when he is freed and wishes to enter the holiness of Israel fully — he then requires immersion again before three — and this will be explained below. And therefore the slave is acquired by his master through money and deed and taking possession — corresponding to three aspects: money corresponds to the aspect of Chochmah — the brain — the aspect of: "in the shadow of wisdom — in the shadow of money" [Koheles 7:12] — the aspect of: "from the right side — the white brain — as silver." The deed corresponds to the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of action — as stated. And therefore the slave acquires himself to go out to full freedom — also through three things: through money — corresponding to Chochmah. Through deed — corresponding to Torah. And through primary limbs [roshei evarim] — corresponding to Malchus. For the slave himself is from the aspect of Malchus (see Maurai Or) — and his essential fullness is from what his master illuminates to him from the light of his holiness and wisdom — through which he somewhat encompasses him in Israel's holiness. Even so he is subjugated to him for his work. And therefore: if his master struck him — he goes free through tooth and eye — which allude to the aspect of Chochmah.

segments.he: וע,כ צותה התורה לפדו תאת הבכור וליתן הפדיון לכהן שהוא מבחי' החסד בחי' חכמה ודעת דקדושה ועל ידם עיקר התגלות התורה בחינת יורו משפטיך ליעקב ותורתך לישראל וכתיב כי שפתי כהן ישמרו דעת ותורה יבקשו מפיהו וע,כ עי"ז נפדה הבן הבכור מסטרא דמותא בח'י הטס"א בחינת עשו שאמר הנה אנכי הולך למות וזכה לחיים שהם מבחי' השכל והחכמה דקדושהבחי' והחכמה תחיה. וזה בחינת החמשה שקלים שנותנין לכהן ומבואר בזוה"ק בא דף מ"ב שזה כנגד הה"א שניתוסף לאברהם וארז"ל (נדרים ל"ב ע"ב) שה"א זאת מרמזת שהשליטו גם על חמשה אברים שדרך היצה"ר להתגרות בהם מחמת שאינם ברשותו של אדם והם שתי עינים שתי אזנים וראש הגויה ונתנם הקב"ה ברשותו של אברהם עיין שם בהמפרשים נמצא שה"א דאברהם מרמזת שנתן לו כח ביותר להתגבר על יצרו וכן ארז"ל בהדיא וה' בירך את אברהם בכל שהשליטו ביצרו וזה ממשיכין ע"י נתינת הה"א שקלים לכהן בעד הבכור: וזה ג"כ בחי' קדושת בכור בהמה טהורה שצריך ליתן לכהן. כי גם הולדת בהמהמ טהורה של ישראל הוא בחי' המשכת השכל הנ"ל כי השכל דקדושה מלובש בכל דבר כי כולם בחכמה עשית בפרט בבהמה טהורה שהיא מבחי' המלכות דקדושה כידוע בפרט כשהיא של ישראל וע"כ צריך ליתן את הבכור שהיא הולדה ראשונה שלה לכהן שכלול מכל התיקונים הנ"ל: וזה ג"כ מצוות פדיון פטר חמור. עיין זוהר בא דף מ"ג שכתוב שם ורזא דא יצה"ר יכול לאחזרא בתיובתא וכו' ע"ש וזה בחי' מה שארז"ל אי אזיל מוטב ואי לאו יעסוק בתורה וכו' כי ע"י שמרגיז אדם יצ"ט על יצה"ר ובפרט ע"י שעוסק ג"כ בתורה עי"ז יכול להכניע את היצה"ר והסט"א שיהיו נעשין בבח'י כסא לקדושה וכמבואר במ"א. וזהבחי' ופטר חמור תפדה בשה היינו שצריך להמתיק הזוהמא של הסט"א הנאחזת בפטר חמור ע"י שיפדה אותו בשה (שהיא מבחי' קדושת ישראל שנקראין שה פזורה וכמובא שם בזוה"ק) ונותן השה לכהן. ואם לא תפדה וערפתו זה בחי' ואי לא אזיל היצה"ר גם ע"י עסק התורה אזי יזכיר לו יום המיתה (ועיי"ש בזוה"ק) ועי"ז דייקא יכול להציל את עצמו מסיטרא דמותא וזוכה לחיים כנ,ל בהלכות שחיטה באריכות קצת שזה בחי' הרוצה לחיות ימית א"ע. וזה וערפתו דייקא כי מאחר שגם לימוד התורה שלו אינו מועיל לו מובן כי הוא ח"ו בבחי' לא זכה נעשה לו סם מות המבפ"נ שזה בחי' יערוף כמטר לקחי שדרז"ל ע"ז (תענית דף ז') אין עריפה אלא הריגה וכו' וע,כ גם כאן וערפתו דייקא ועי"ז בעצמו שמזכירא עצמו שנפל למדריגה פחותה כזו שגם התורה נעשית לו סם המות ח"ו שזה בחי' וערפתו עי"ז נופל עליו חרדה גדולה ונכנע היצה"ר וזוכה לחים כנ"ל. וע,F פרשה קדש והיה כי יביאך המדברים מקדושת בכורים מרמזים לאותיות י"ה של השם הוהי ית' כמבואר בזוה"ק כי הם בבח'י המשכת המוחין הק' שהם בחי' אותיות יוד ה"א הנ"ל:
segments.en:
[§6]
For there are thirty-two teeth — corresponding to thirty-two paths of Chochmah — as is known. And likewise: eyes are named for wisdom — as stated. And likewise in other primary limbs — which also allude to the aspects of life-force and wisdom in that limb. For the head is from the aspect of reishis Chochmah. It emerges: not only did the master not illuminate to him the aspect of life-force and wisdom — but even damaged the diminishment of the aspect of life-force and wisdom in him. Therefore the Torah penalized him — that his slave goes out to full freedom. And one compels the master to write him a bill of manumission — and then he is no longer subjugated to his master — to receive holiness from him. Only he receives life-force from the general holiness of Israel — in which the aspect of life-force and holiness from the light of holy Chochmah shines — as stated. And therefore: he does not go out to freedom until the master does this with intention — flowing from the aspect of his own wisdom. And therefore: it is not permitted to free one's slave — unless for the sake of a mitzvah. For who knows whether he is at the level to merit Israel's holiness fully — since at his root he is from non-Jews — only he was sold to an Israelite. And therefore: his merit is to be subjugated to Israel forever — in the aspect of: "forever shall you work them" [Vayikra 25:46]. And if one frees him — it is possible that this is a damage and stumbling block — and also for the master and owner. For one may thereby give some illumination and flow to those who are proximate to the side of the sitra achra — G-d forbid. And therefore: it is permitted to free him for the sake of a mitzvah. For since the foundation of the matter of manumission is immediately encompassed in a matter of mitzvah — the aspect of holy Malchus — therefore there is no longer concern for all of this — for "a guardian of the commandment shall know no evil" — and presumably there will be no damage or stumbling through this.

Siman 268 and on — Laws of Gerim [Converts]
סִימָן רס״ח וְכוּ׳ — הִלְכוֹת גֵּרִים

segments.he: סימן שכ"ב וכו'
segments.en:
[§1]
The laws of converts. And therefore a convert also requires circumcision — to remove from him the orlah and filth of the sitra achra. And to immerse in water — the aspect of the waters of daas and wisdom. And it must be by day — the aspect of the illumination of Chochmah. And likewise it must be before three fit to judge — alluding to the three Patriarchs — encompassed in the aspect of drawing these rectifications. And therefore one informs him of the lowliness of Israel — for they are of the aspect of holy Malchus — which is now in the aspect of lowliness and poverty. And one informs him of the essentials of the religion — which are: the unity of Hashem (the aspect of accepting the yoke of Heavenly Kingship) — and the prohibition of idolatry (the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra). And one informs him of the punishments of commandments (which comes from the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of the awe of Malchus — the aspect of: "the wrath of the king — messengers of death") — and likewise: one informs him of the rewards of commandments (which flows at its root from the aspect of supernal Chochmah — from which is the essential delight — etc. — the aspect of: "how great is Your goodness" — and it is written: "to bequeath to those who love Me — substance" — as is known). And one informs him that through performing these commandments — the aspect of holy Malchus — one will merit the life of the World to Come — the aspect of supernal Chochmah — the essential life. And this: one concludes: "and there is no perfectly righteous one except for the possessor of wisdom" (corresponding to the aspect of Chochmah mentioned) "who performs these commandments and knows" (corresponding to the aspect of Malchus and Torah study mentioned) — for wisdom alone has no fullness — only when one's deeds exceed one's wisdom — for it is impossible to merit the light of Chochmah except through the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of action. And this is hinted in the letter tzaddik itself — which is the form of Yud (the aspect of Chochmah) and Nun (the aspect of Malchus) — and the Yud turns its face away from the Nun. For the fullness of receiving the light of Chochmah is to know that Chochmah is still concealed from one — in the aspect of: "I said I will be wise — but it is far from me" [Koheles 7:23] — as explained elsewhere. And also: at the time of holy service and work of the righteous — one must set aside all of one's wisdom — and do His will in complete wholeness and simplicity — etc. — as elaborated in Likutay Moharan, Siman 5. And know: through this the righteous merits the fullness of the attainment of wisdom even more — as elaborated there. And therefore one must investigate and examine whether one is not coming to convert for money — and the like. For the essential conversion is to accept upon oneself the holiness of Israel — to do everything for the sake of Heaven — and to gaze only at the intellect in every thing.

[§2]
But when one is not in this aspect — only wants to convert for one's heart's desires — and the like — then one is from the aspect of the sitra achra — the aspect of Esav who despised the birthright — the aspect of holy intellect — and the aspect of: "the fool desires not understanding." And how is it possible to bring one into the holiness of Israel — since the beginning of one's strengthening is in the very opposite. And likewise: one informs one of the heaviness of the yoke of Torah and the effort in performing it — etc. — so that one will withdraw — etc. For one fears that perhaps one's intention is not completely for the sake of Heaven. And therefore it is possible that some damage could fall upon holiness thereby — G-d forbid — in the aspect of: "converts are difficult for Israel like a leprous lesion" — specifically — the aspect of nega — which comes from the sitra achra — G-d forbid. And therefore it is possible that the very matter of one's conversion is an act of the accusing force — in this aspect — since sometimes it dresses itself in mitzvos — in order to cast some damage upon holy things — G-d forbid — as stated. And therefore: if one sees that one truly comes to convert out of love — one accepts one. For then one knows — on the contrary — that one is from the aspect of the clarifications and holy sparks — that holy Malchus has clarified from among the sitra achra — in the aspect of: "one who swallowed something forbidden — and spits it out." And therefore: a convert who converts — is like a newborn child. For now the essential of one's birth — for what was born among the non-Jews — was only in the aspect of robbery and distortion and crookedness from the sitra achra. For behold: now it has been clarified and revealed as truth — that one is not from their side at all — but from the side of holiness — only: one was stuck there until now. And now that one has returned to the place of one's root and resting place — this is the essential of one's birth.

segments.he: הלכות חלה ותרומות ומעשרות ומתנות עניים וראשית הגז. כי ע"י שמפרישין חלה שנקראת ראשית ומרחמזת לבחי' חכמה שבלמכות כמבואר בכתבים ונותנין אותה לכהן שכלול מכל התיקונים הנ"ל עי"ז ממשיכין קדושה על הלחם של ישראל שיזין אותו ויקבל על ידו חיות דקדושה מבחי' החכמה העליונה. וע"כ העושה כל עיסתו חלה לא עשה כלום עד שישייר מקצתו, כי זה עיקר בחי' מה שצריכין להסתכל על השכל שיש בכל ד בר בכדי שיתקרב להשי"ת עי"ז הדבר. היינו כי מאחר שהשכל והחיות דקדושה נשתלשל ונתלבש בדברים גופניים וגשמיים שהם מכסים ומחשיכים על האור השכל דקדושה המחיה אותם ע"כ צריך האדם לתת לב על זה ולהתסכל היטב על הפנימיות של הדבר שהוא השכל שהוא בחי' ראשית וידע שזהו העיקר והחיות של כל דבר וגוף הדבר בעצמו הוא רק בבחי' שיריים ולבושים שמתלבש בו אור השכל והחיות ועי"ז מאיר לו השכל שיתקרב להשי"ת ע"י כל דבר שבעולם אפילו ע"י ענינים גשמיים וזה עיקרשלימות הבריאה בבחי' כל מה שברא הקב"ה לא ברא אלא לכבודו וכו'. משא"כ אם אינו משייר כלל רק עושה הכל חלה אזי אינו נקרא חלה או תרומה כי שוב אינו ניכר מעלת האור והשכל של מהות גוף הדבר. כיעיקר מעלת הואר הוא בבחי' ויבדל א' בין האור ובין החשך וכו' ואז ויהי ערב ויהי בקר יום אחד כי עי"ז נתתקן גם בחי' החשך שיכירו גם ע"י אחדותו ית' שזה בחי' יום אחד שדרז"ל שהיה הקב"ה יחיד בעולמו זה ג"כ בחי' התרומה שנקראת ראשית דגנך וצריך ליתנה לכהן. והמעשר ללוי כי המעשר הוא בחי' מלכות כידוכע ולוי הוא בחי' גבורות שורש המלכות. והלוי צריך להפריש תרומת מעשר לכהן בכדי לחבר בחי' המלכות עם בחי' אור השכל העליון וע"י כל זה נתקדש הדגן והתירוש והיצהר וכיוצא בזה שיהיו יכולין לאכלם ולשתותם בקדושת ישראל כראוי בשלימות. וזה ג"כ בחי' מתנות עניים לקט שכחה ופאה. כי ע, יכל זה נותנין כח לבחיח' מלכות שהיא בבחי' עניות מסכן וחכם הנ"ל. וע,כ אחר וידוי מעשרות שבפ' כי תבא מסיים בתפלה ואומר השקיפה ממעון קדשך וכו'. כי ע,י כל זה התפלה מקובלת כנ"ל. וזV ג"כ בחי' ניתנת ראשית הגז לכהן. כי רוב המלבושים ביים הראשונים היו מצמר כ"ש כבשים ללבושיך וכיוצא בזה הרבהוכבר נתברא שמלבושי ישראל הם מבחי' מלכות ושרשם מבחי' אור החכמה העליונה בחי' עוטה אור כשלמה. וזה בחינת מה שמובא במ"א מענין שהחמה עשתה מלבוש להלבנה. וזה בחינת חדתותי דסיהרא. ועל כן צריכין ליתן ראשית גיזת צמרו לכהן ושיהיה בו שיעור כדי שיעשה לו הכהן בגד קטן. ועי"ז נמשך קדושה על כל הצמר שלו שכל המלבושים שיעשו מהם יחול עליהם קדושת ישראל באופן שיהיו זוכים להתקרב על ידם לעבוד תהשי"ת בלשימות
segments.en:
Siman 270 and on — Laws of the Torah Scroll
סִימָן ע״ר וְכוּ׳ — הִלְכוֹת סֵפֶר תּוֹרָה

segments.he: סימן של"ד
segments.en:
[§1]
The laws of the Torah scroll. The positive commandment upon every man of Israel to write for himself a Torah scroll. For the Torah scroll itself is the aspect of the central pillar — the aspect of Yaakov — as cited in the Tikkunim — and its root is from supernal Chochmah — the aspect of: "fruits of wisdom — Torah from above." And therefore it is a commandment for each one to write it — for the writing is from the aspect of Malchus — (see Maurai Or) — and through this one draws these rectifications. Meaning: one gives strength to holy Malchus to prevail — etc. — the aspect of: "write this as a remembrance in the book" — said regarding the war with Amalek — the general totality of the kingdom of the sitra achra. And through holy writing one subdues it — and through this one merits to receive holy Chochmah — the root of holy Torah. And therefore: even if one's forebears left one a Torah scroll — it is a commandment to write one's own. For every Jew must engage in this himself — to give strength to holy Malchus — and merit through this to receive from the holy light of intellect — each one according to one's aspect. For one was created only for this: b'gin d'yishtamodain leih. And therefore: even though one generally knows the matter of faith in His divinity from the transmission of one's forebears — even so: one is obligated to engage in this oneself — to draw the attainment of His divinity according to one's intellect and Torah and service. The aspect of: "know the G-d of your father" [Divrei HaYamim I 28:9] — etc. — as cited. And therefore: one may not sell it — etc. — the aspect of: "acquire truth — and do not sell wisdom and discipline and understanding" [Mishlei 23:23] — for this is the aspect of Esav — who despised the birthright (the aspect of the general totality of these rectifications) and it is said of him: "and he sold his birthright" — etc. And therefore: one does not write a Torah scroll on the hide of impure animal or beast or fowl — which are from the sitra achra. Only on the hide of pure animal or beast or fowl — which are from the side of holiness. And therefore the hide must be tanned for its own sake [lishmah]. For since in the animality there is the extra hold of the sitra achra — the aspect of the spirit of folly — the spirit of the yetzer hara — the aspect of: "he is compared to the beasts that are silenced" — and as our Sages taught about the sitra achra — it committed an act of an animal — etc. — therefore it is specifically necessary that Israel — or with the assistance of Israel at minimum — tan the hide — and say with a full mouth that one is doing this for the sake of the holiness of the Torah scroll. And through this one drives away and subdues the power of the hold of the sitra achra — and draws upon it the holiness of the Torah scroll.

[§2]
And therefore the Torah scroll requires ruling [sirtut] — so that the writing be straight. The aspect of the general totality of these rectifications — which are made in truth and uprightness. For holy intellect — Torah — and holy Malchus — all are in the aspect of truth and uprightness — the aspect of: "for the paths of Hashem are straight" [Hoshea 14:10] — the opposite of the way of the yetzer hara and the sitra achra — the klippa of Esav — whose ways are only in crookedness and deceit and falsehood — the aspect of: "those who abandon the paths of uprightness" [Mishlei 2:13] — the aspect of: "and all the straight they make crooked" [Michah 3:9]. And this too is the aspect of what sometimes the yetzer hara dresses in a matter of mitzvah — in order to bring one to transgression — which is a crooked and winding and twisted and corrupted path — for it begins in this and ends in that. The aspect of: "there is a path that seems straight to a man — and its end is the ways of death" [Mishlei 14:12]. But the way of holy Torah is truth and straight from its beginning to its end — the aspect of the ruling — so that everything be straight. And also: the writing must not go outside the line — neither above nor below. The aspect of what one must contract one's wisdom and intellect — so that it not go outside the boundary of holiness below — G-d forbid — and also not above — in the aspect of: "in what is beyond you — do not inquire" — as explained elsewhere. And therefore the Torah scroll must be written with the right hand. The aspect of Chochmah — the aspect of: "from the right side — the white brain — as silver" — the aspect of the yetzer tov — which is in the aspect of: "the heart of the wise is to his right."

segments.he: הלכות נידוי וחרם. כי הקדושה היא בחי' קומה שלימה של רמ"ח איברים וע"כ יש בפרשת קריאת שמע (שהם כלל קבלת עומ"ש ועול תורה ומצוות) רמ"ח תיבו תכידוע ושורש הרמ"ח איברים הם מטיפת החכמה שבמוח שכלולה משני פעמים ע,ב ול"ב נתיבות החכמה גימטריא רמ"ח כמובא בשם עץ החיים. וזה לעומת זה. קומת הסט"א נקראת חרם ר"ל בבחי' שקץ תשקצנו וכו' כי חרם הוא. וע,כ כל בניני היצה"ר והסט"א נקראים מצודים וחרמים כ"ש עיר קטנה ודרז,ל (נדרים ל"ע ע"ב) זה הגוף ואנשים בה מעט אלו האיברים ובא עליה מלך גדול זה היצה"ר ובנה עליה מצודים וחרמים אלו עוונות ונמצא בה איש מסכן וחכם זה היצ"ט ומילט הוא את העיר בחכמתו אלו תשובה ומעש"ט וכו'ץ. נמצא מבואר כי העוונות הבאים מצד יצה,ר הם בחי' חרמים כי הוא בעצמו חרם כנ"ל. וזה שכתבו אצל עיר הנדחת שנמשכו אחר עצת היצה"ר לעבוד ע,ז ח"ו ונאמר בה החרם אותה וכו' ולא ידבק בידך מאומה מן החרם למען ישוב ה' מרון אפו כי כל זמן שהע"ז הזאת של היצה"ר בעולם חרון אף ורוגז בעולם ח"ו וכמרגיזין בח'י הקדושה והיצ"ט על יצה"ר ומחרימין ומכניעין אותו עי"ז נמתק הרוגז והחרון אף ונמשך רחמים וזה ונתן לך רחמים ורחמך וכו'. וזה שארז,ל (מועד קטן דף י"ז) על ענין החרם כשנכנסת נכנסת ברמ"ח איברים שנאמר והיצתה העיר חרם וכו' (ועיין חידושי אגדות שם) וכשהיא יוצאת יוצאת ברמ"ח איברים שנאמר ברוגז רחם תזכור היינו נ"ל. כי עשעושין תשובה ונתעוררין לעשות מהדין והורגז שהוא שורש בחי' היצה"ר כמבואר במ"א וכשמרגיזין זה הרוגז והדין על היצה"ר בעצמו בבחי' לעולם ירגיז אדם יצ"ט על יצה,ר עי"ז נעשין מאותיות חרם ח"ו אותיות רחם בחי' ברוגז רחם תזכור כנ"ל. ועיין בזוה"ק קרח דף קע"ט לענין כל חרם בישראל לך יהיה ותבין ביותר. וזה שמובא כי מלכות גימטריא שני פעמים רחם והוא ע"ד שארז"ל ה' ה'. ה'קודם שיחטא ה' לאחר שיחטא. כי המלכות דקדושה ששרשה בחכמה העליונה שהוא בח'י חסד ורחמים ע"כ לא די שהיא בבחי' רחמים על האדם קודם שיחטא ונותנת לו כח ושכל להתגבר על יצרו ולהנצל מן החטא אלא אף גם לאחר שיחטא ח"ו אם מודה וועזב וחוזר בתשובה אז היא מקרבת אותו בחסד וברחמים כ,ש ומודה ועוזב ירוחם בחי' ברוגז רחם תזכור. וזה בחי' רחם ארחמנו נאום ה' ובזה תבין כמה הלכות וענינים שבסימן זה:
segments.en:
[§3]
And therefore: one does not make the Torah scroll longer than its circumference — nor the circumference greater than the length. For the length alludes to the aspect of Chochmah — from which is the essential length of days — the aspect of: "wisdom gives life" — etc. — and from there is the essential length of patience — the aspect of: "a wise man's patience makes his face long" (see Maurai Or). And the circumference alludes to the aspect of Malchus — which is called the cycle of the year — the aspect of: "a woman surrounds a man" [Yirmiyahu 31:21] — as cited in the holy Zohar. And also: Malchus is the aspect of faith — which is the aspect of circles — the aspect of makifin [encompassing lights] — as cited in his teachings in Likutay Moharan, Siman 7. And therefore: the Torah scroll — which encompasses both of them — through which these two aspects are connected and united — therefore its length must equal its circumference — etc. — the aspect of: "and the moonlight shall be as the sunlight" — as explained within. And therefore one must conclude the Torah at the middle of the last line on the page. For the sof davar is the aspect of Malchus — as stated. And therefore one must finish it at the end of the page — for through it is the essential power of holy Malchus. But if one finishes at the very end of the last line of the page — it would appear as if one has truly already finished the Torah from its beginning to its end — and its ultimate fullness. And in truth: "I have seen an end to every purpose — but Your commandment is exceedingly broad" [Tehillim 119:96] — for the light of holy Torah is without end or limit — as it is written: "its measure is longer than the earth" — etc. And therefore one must conclude at the middle of the last line of the page — in order to allude that even if one learned the entire Torah in its fullness from beginning to end — one still stands at its middle. For: "doubly so — for wisdom" [Iyov 11:6] — and there is still much more that one has not begun to attain at all. And therefore one must immediately begin anew: "In the beginning" — etc. — and again and again — indefinitely. It emerges that one is always in the middle. And this itself is also the aspect of holy Malchus — the aspect of the poor wise man — as explained within. Meaning: the more one merits to attain through the aspect of Malchus the light of holy Chochmah — the more one recognizes one's poverty and lowliness — that one has nothing of one's own — only what one receives from the light of Chochmah — and one realizes one has not yet begun to attain the light of Chochmah at all. And this is the aspect of: "before the eyes of all Israel — in the beginning."
